So that the number of possible Durudhura yogas=75+70+30+5=180.
passages.summary: The translator's note works out that there are 180 possible Durudhura yogas by counting how the remaining planets can fill the 12th house from the Moon for each arrangement in the 2nd house. It only counts the varieties.

passages.text: A person born in a Sunapha yoga will be possessed of self-acquired property, will be a king or will resemble a king, and will be a man of intelligence, wealth and renown.
passages.summary: The text says a person born in Sunapha yoga will have self-acquired property, will be a king or like a king, and will be intelligent, wealthy and renowned.

passages.text: A person born in an Anapha yoga will be a man of influence and authority, will be free from diseases, will have a control over his passions, will be of great renown, will be in the enjoyment of all manner of pleasures, will wear neat dress and will be free from grief.
passages.summary: The text says a person born in Anapha yoga will have influence and authority, be free from disease, control his passions, be greatly renowned, enjoy all kinds of pleasures, dress neatly and be free from grief.

passages.text: A person born in a Durudhura yoga will be in the enjoyment of all manner of pleasures, will be possessed of wealth and chariot, will be liberal in his gifts and will have good servants.
passages.summary: The text says a person born in Durudhura yoga will enjoy all kinds of pleasures, own wealth and a chariot, give generously and have good servants.

passages.text: A person born in a Kemadruma yoga, though he may belong to a king's family, will be dirty, afflicted with grief, will do deeds not suited to his rank in life, will be poor, will serve under others and will be wicked.
passages.summary: The text says a person born in Kemadruma yoga, even if of royal family, will be dirty, grief-stricken, act beneath his rank, be poor, serve others and be wicked.

passages.text: If the yoga planet be Mars, the person will be active, fond of fight and wealthy, and will engage in deeds without thought.
passages.summary: The text says that if Mars is the planet forming the yoga, the person will be active, fond of fighting, wealthy, and will act without thinking.

passages.text: If the yoga planet be Mercury, the person will be skilled in work, will be of good speech and learned in the arts (a).
passages.notes: (a). In music, dance, painting, &c.
passages.summary: The text says that if Mercury is the planet forming the yoga, the person will be skilled in work, well-spoken and learned in the arts.

passages.text: If the yoga planet be Jupiter, a person will be wealthy and virtuous, will live for ever in comfort and will be respected by the king.
passages.summary: The text says that if Jupiter is the planet forming the yoga, the person will be wealthy and virtuous, always live in comfort and be respected by the king.

passages.text: If the yoga planet be Venus, a person will be afflicted with sexual passion, will be very wealthy and in the enjoyment of all manner of pleasures.
passages.summary: The text says that if Venus is the planet forming the yoga, the person will be afflicted with sexual passion, very wealthy and will enjoy all kinds of pleasures.

passages.text: If the yoga planet be Saturn, a person will enjoy the wealth, property and servants of others, will engage in various deeds and will be the chief of parties of men (a).
passages.notes: (a). If two or more planets be yoga planets the effects described for them all will come to pass.
passages.summary: The text says that if Saturn is the planet forming the yoga, the person will enjoy others' wealth, property and servants, undertake various deeds and lead groups of men. The note adds that when several planets form the yoga, all their effects occur.

passages.text: If the birth occur by day, the Moon will bring on misery if she occupy the visible hemisphere, and will bring on prosperity if she occupy the invisible hemisphere ; if otherwise, the results will be the reverse of these (b).
passages.notes: (b). That is, if the birth occur by night, the Moon will bring on misery if she occupy the invisible hemisphere and prosperity if she occupy the visible hemisphere.
passages.summary: The text says that in a day birth the Moon brings misery when above the horizon and prosperity when below it, and in a night birth the reverse.

passages.text: If all the benefic planets (a) occupy the Upachaya places (b) from the ascendant at the time of birth, a person will be very rich and if they occupy the Upachaya places from the Moon, he will be moderately rich. If two of the planets occupy the Upachaya places a person will be moderately wealthy and if one of them occupy such places he will possess small wealth (c). Even if the person be born in other malefic Yogas (d) the present yoga will take effect to their exclusion (e).
passages.notes:
(a). Mercury, Jupiter and Venus.
(b). The 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th houses from the ascendant.
(c). Or poor. If benefic planets occupy the Upachaya places both from the ascendant and from the Moon a person will be exceedingly rich.
(d). Such as Kemadruma yoga.
(e). That is, suppose a person to be born in a Kemadruma yoga and suppose the benefic planets to occupy the Upachaya places from the ascendant or the Moon or both, the person will become rich and not poor.
passages.summary: The text says that if all the benefic planets occupy the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th houses from the ascendant the person will be very rich, and moderately rich if from the Moon; two such planets give moderate wealth and one gives small wealth. It adds that this yoga takes effect even over other malefic yogas such as Kemadruma.

passages.text: If at the time of birth the Sun and the Moon occupy together a sign of the Zodiac, the person born will be a maker of fire engines (a) and will work in stones;
passages.notes: (a). Engines of destruction according to Commentator.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun and the Moon together in one sign will make fire engines and work in stones. The translator's footnote says the commentator takes these as engines of destruction.

passages.text: if the Sun and Mars occupy a sign together, the person will be addicted to sinful deeds;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun and Mars together in one sign will be given to sinful deeds.

passages.text: if the Sun and Mercury occupy a sign together, the person will be skilled in work, will be intelligent and famous, and will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun and Mercury together in one sign will be skilled in work, intelligent and famous, and will live in comfort.

passages.text: if the Sun and Jupiter occupy a sign together, the person will be cruel and will work for other men;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun and Jupiter together in one sign will be cruel and will work for others.

passages.text: if the Sun and Venus occupy a sign together the person will gain money by engaging in public sports and by the use of weapons,
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun and Venus together in one sign will earn money through public sports and the use of weapons.

passages.text: and if the Sun and Saturn occupy a sign together, the person will be skilled in metal work and in earthen-ware.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun and Saturn together in one sign will be skilled in metal work and earthenware.

passages.text: If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be the Moon and Mars the person will earn money by the sale of works of art, of women, of liquor, and of pots and will give trouble to his mother;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Moon and Mars together in one sign will earn money by selling works of art, women, liquor and pots, and will trouble his mother.
passages.withheldReason: Trade in women; harm to mother.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] the Moon and Mercury, the person will be of sweet speech, skilled in literary interpretation and will become popular and famous;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Moon and Mercury together in one sign will speak sweetly, be skilled in literary interpretation, and become popular and famous.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] the Moon and Jupiter, the person will defeat his enemies, will be an important person in his family, will not be of firm views and will be greatly rich;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Moon and Jupiter together in one sign will defeat his enemies, be important in his family, lack firm views, and be very rich.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] the Moon and Venus, the person will be skilled in cloth work (a);
passages.notes: (a). In weaving, stitching, dyeing, buying and selling cloths.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Moon and Venus together in one sign will be skilled in cloth work, which the translator explains as weaving, stitching, dyeing and trading in cloth.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] the Moon and Saturn, the person will be the son of a re-married woman (b).
passages.notes: (b). The Sanscrit term for the woman is Punarbhu. She is said to be a woman, who, out of sexual passion, quits her husband and marries a person of her own caste whether or not she may have joined in sexual union.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Moon and Saturn together in one sign will be the son of a remarried woman; the translator's footnote explains the Sanskrit term for such a woman.
passages.withheldReason: Low social birth; sexual immorality of mother.

passages.text: If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be Mars and Mercury, the person will deal in roots and the like, in oil, in works of art and will be skilled in duels;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Mars and Mercury together in one sign will deal in roots, oil and works of art, and will be skilled in duels.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] Mars and Jupiter, the person will be the chief of a town or a king, will acquire money or will be [a person of very high status and influence];
passages.printedText: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] Mars and Jupiter, the person will be the chief of a town or a king, will acquire money or will be a Brahmin;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Mars and Jupiter together in one sign will be the head of a town or a king, will gain money, or will be a Brahmin.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] Mars and Venus, the person will protect cows, will engage in duels, will be skilled in work, will indulge in sexual union with the wives of other men and will be a gambler;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Mars and Venus together in one sign will tend cows, fight duels, be skilled in work, have relations with other men's wives, and gamble.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] Mars and Saturn, the person will be afflicted with grief, will be a liar, and will be despised by others.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Mars and Saturn together in one sign will suffer grief, be a liar, and be despised by others.

passages.text: If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be Mercury and Jupiter, the person will be skilled in duels, will be fond of music and learned in dance;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Mercury and Jupiter together in one sign will be skilled in duels, fond of music, and learned in dance.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] Mercury and Venus the person will be one of good speech, and will be a ruler over countries and over men;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Mercury and Venus together in one sign will speak well and rule over countries and men.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] Mercury and Saturn, the person will be skilled in deceiving others, and will reject the advice of his preceptor;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Mercury and Saturn together in one sign will be skilled at deceiving others and will reject his teacher's advice.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] Jupiter and Venus, the person will be learned in some respectable department of knowledge, will possess wealth, a wife and various virtues;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Jupiter and Venus together in one sign will be learned in a respectable branch of knowledge and will have wealth, a wife and many virtues.

passages.text: [If the double planets occupying together a sign of the Zodiac at the time of birth be] Jupiter and Saturn, the person will be a barber, a potman or a cook.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with Jupiter and Saturn together in one sign will be a barber, a potman or a cook.

passages.text: (4). The Sun and Jupiter, he will be earnest in work, will be a favorite with the king and rich.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun and Jupiter in one sign the person will be earnest in work, favoured by the king, and rich.

passages.text: (5). The Sun and Venus, he will acquire wealth through women, will have kinsmen and enemies and will be intelligent.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun and Venus in one sign the person will gain wealth through women, have kinsmen and enemies, and be intelligent.

passages.text: (6). The Sun and Saturn, he will be of dull understanding and subject to his enemies.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun and Saturn in one sign the person will be of dull understanding and subject to his enemies.

passages.text: (7). Moon and Mars, he will be bold and born of a high family; will be virtuous, wealthy and possessed of good qualities.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon and Mars in one sign the person will be bold, of high family, virtuous, wealthy and of good qualities.

passages.text: (8). Moon and Mercury, he will be charitable, learned in sciences, and possessed of excellent qualities.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon and Mercury in one sign the person will be charitable, learned in the sciences, and of excellent qualities.

passages.text: (9). Moon and Jupiter, he will protect good and pious men and will be very intelligent.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon and Jupiter in one sign the person will protect good and pious men and be very intelligent.

passages.text: (10). Moon and Venus, he will be a sinner and a Merchant.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon and Venus in one sign the person will be a sinner and a merchant.

passages.text: (11). Moon and Saturn, he will possess a bad wife, will ill-treat his father and will be poor.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon and Saturn in one sign the person will have a bad wife, ill-treat his father, and be poor.

passages.text: (12). Mars and Mercury, he will be of good speech and learned in medicine, arts and sciences.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars and Mercury in one sign the person will speak well and be learned in medicine, arts and sciences.

passages.text: (13). Mars and Jupiter, he will be of strong sexual passion, will possess excellent qualities and will be a mathematician.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars and Jupiter in one sign the person will have strong sexual passion, excellent qualities, and be a mathematician.

passages.text: (14). Mars and Venus, he will be fond of fight and of the world, and will be deceitful.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars and Venus in one sign the person will be fond of fighting and of the world, and deceitful.

passages.text: (15). Mars and Saturn, he will be litigious, fond of music and of a dull understanding.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars and Saturn in one sign the person will be litigious, fond of music, and of dull understanding.

passages.text: (16). Mercury and Jupiter, he will be of good speech, beautiful and very rich.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mercury and Jupiter in one sign the person will speak well, be beautiful, and be very rich.

passages.text: (17). Mercury and Venus, he will be a ruler over countries and over men.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mercury and Venus in one sign the person will rule over countries and men.

passages.text: (18). Mercury and Saturn, he will be deceitful and will not be open to the advice of his preceptor.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mercury and Saturn in one sign the person will be deceitful and will not heed his teacher's advice.

passages.text: (19). Jupiter and Venus, he will be of bright appearance, a favorite with the king, will be very intelligent and skilled in work.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be bright in appearance, favoured by the king, very intelligent and skilled in work.

passages.text: (20). Jupiter and Saturn, he will be a sculptor and will protect cows.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be a sculptor and will tend cows.

passages.text: (21). Venus and Saturn, will be skilled in duels.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be skilled in duels.

passages.text: II.—OF THREE PLANETS. Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be (1). The Sun, the Moon and Mars—the person will destroy the family of his enemy, will be rich and just.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon and Mars in one sign the person will destroy his enemy's family and will be rich and just.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (2). The Sun, the Moon and Mercury, he will resemble a king and will be learned and famous.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon and Mercury in one sign the person will be like a king, learned and famous.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (3). The Sun, Moon and Jupiter, he will be possessed of many good qualities and will be learned.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon and Jupiter in one sign the person will have many good qualities and be learned.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (4). The Sun, Moon and Venus, he will commit adultery, will be cruel, will be subject to fear from his enemy and will be rich.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon and Venus in one sign the person will commit adultery, be cruel, fear his enemy, and be rich.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (5). The Sun, Moon and Saturn, he will be a man of wrong views, will be deceitful and will travel to foreign lands.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon and Saturn in one sign the person will hold wrong views, be deceitful, and travel abroad.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (6). The Sun, Mars and Mercury—he will be without enjoyment of any kind and will have sons, wealth and wife.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars and Mercury in one sign the person will lack enjoyment of any kind yet have sons, wealth and a wife.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (7). The Sun, Mars and Jupiter, he will be fond of sexual enjoyment, will be considerate, will be a commander of armies or a magistrate.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars and Jupiter in one sign the person will be fond of sexual pleasure, considerate, and a commander of armies or a magistrate.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (8). The Sun, Mars and Venus, he will be afflicted with diseases of the eye, will live in comfort and born in a good family.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars and Venus in one sign the person will suffer eye disease, live in comfort, and be born in a good family.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (9). The Sun, Mars and Saturn, he will be separated from his kinsmen, will be dumb, will suffer from diseases and will be rich.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars and Saturn in one sign the person will be separated from his kin, be mute, suffer diseases, and be rich.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (10). The Sun, Mercury and Jupiter, he will be of sound views, will be learned, wealthy and famous.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mercury and Jupiter in one sign the person will hold sound views and be learned, wealthy and famous.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (11). The Sun, Mercury and Venus, he will be of soft body, will be learned and famous and will live in comfort.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mercury and Venus in one sign the person will have a soft body, be learned and famous, and live in comfort.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (12). The Sun, Mercury and Saturn, he will be without kinsmen and poor; will hate mankind and will be of vicious habits.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mercury and Saturn in one sign the person will be without kin and poor, hate mankind, and have vicious habits.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (13). The Sun, Jupiter and Venus, he will possess a good wife and children, will be very intelligent, will suffer from diseases of the eye and will be rich.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will have a good wife and children, be very intelligent, suffer eye disease, and be rich.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (14). The Sun, Jupiter and Saturn, he will be fearless, will be liked by the king and will be of quiet and excellent disposition.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be fearless, liked by the king, and of quiet, excellent disposition.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (15). The Sun, Venus and Saturn, he will be of bad reputation and will be haughty and insolent.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will have a bad reputation and be haughty and insolent.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (16). The Moon, Mars and Mercury, he will be gluttonous, will be addicted to wicked deeds and will abuse other people.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars and Mercury in one sign the person will be gluttonous, given to wicked deeds, and abusive to others.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (17). The Moon, Mars and Jupiter, he will be of angry speech, will be of strong sexual passion and will be beautiful.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars and Jupiter in one sign the person will speak angrily, have strong sexual passion, and be beautiful.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (18). The Moon, Mars and Venus, he will be of bad conduct, will have no sons and will be fond of travels.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars and Venus in one sign the person will be of bad conduct, have no sons, and be fond of travel.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (19). The Moon, Mars and Saturn, he will be virtuous and wealthy, will have a bad wife and will be litigious.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars and Saturn in one sign the person will be virtuous and wealthy, have a bad wife, and be litigious.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (20). The Moon, Mercury and Jupiter—he will be charitable and learned in sciences, will protect good and pious men and will be of good speech.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mercury and Jupiter in one sign the person will be charitable, learned in the sciences, a protector of good men, and well spoken.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (21). The Moon, Mercury and Venus—will be learned, will be addicted to low deeds and will have numerous servants.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mercury and Venus in one sign the person will be learned, given to low deeds, and have many servants.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (22). The Moon, Mercury and Saturn—will be liberal in gift, will be respected by the king and will be possessed of good qualities.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mercury and Saturn in one sign the person will be generous, respected by the king, and of good qualities.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (23). The Moon, Jupiter and Venus—will be intelligent, will have good sons and will be skilled in works of art.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be intelligent, have good sons, and be skilled in works of art.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (24). The Moon, Jupiter and Saturn—will be learned in sciences, will be fond of old women and will be as happy as a king.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be learned in the sciences, fond of old women, and as happy as a king.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (25). The Moon, Venus and Saturn—will be learned in the Vedas, will be the king's chaplain and will be liked by all people.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be learned in the Vedas, be the king's chaplain, and be liked by all.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (26). Mars, Mercury and Jupiter—will be fond of music, of Vedas, of literature and of drama.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Mercury and Jupiter in one sign the person will be fond of music, the Vedas, literature and drama.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (27). Mars, Mercury and Venus—will be of defective organs, will be born of a bad family and will be of settled views.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Mercury and Venus in one sign the person will have defective organs, be born of a bad family, and hold settled views.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (28). Mars, Mercury and Saturn—will serve under other men, will suffer from diseases of the eye and will be fond of travels.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Mercury and Saturn in one sign the person will serve others, suffer eye disease, and be fond of travel.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (29). Mars, Jupiter and Venus—will be liked by the king, will have good sons, and will live in comfort.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be liked by the king, have good sons, and live in comfort.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (30). Mars, Jupiter and Saturn—will be of thin body, without comfort, respectable and given up to a vicious course of life.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be thin, without comfort, respectable, and given to a vicious way of life.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] (31.) Mars, Venus and Saturn—will have bad sons and will ever be of pure mind.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will have bad sons and will always be pure of mind.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] 32. Mercury, Jupiter and Venus—will conquer over his enemies and will be of wide-spread fame.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mercury, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will conquer his enemies and be widely famous.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] 33. Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn—will live in great comfort, will be wealthy and will be attached to his wife.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will live in great comfort, be wealthy, and be attached to his wife.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] 34. Mercury, Venus and Saturn—will tell lies.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mercury, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will tell lies.

passages.text: [Again, if the Yoga planets occupying a single sign be] 35. Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be of clear understanding and will be happy and famous.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will have clear understanding and be happy and famous.

passages.text: III.—OF FOUR PLANETS. Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be (1). The Sun, Moon, Mars and Mercury—the person will be deceitful, skilled in the art of writing and will suffer from diseases.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars and Mercury in one sign the person will be deceitful, skilled in writing, and suffer diseases.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (2). The Sun, Moon, Mars and Jupiter—will be rich, famous, intelligent and liked by the king and will be free from diseases and from griefs.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars and Jupiter in one sign the person will be rich, famous, intelligent, liked by the king, and free from disease and grief.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (3). The Sun, the Moon, Mars and Venus—will have a wife and children, will be learned, a moderate eater, happy, skilled in work and merciful.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars and Venus in one sign the person will have a wife and children and be learned, moderate in eating, happy, skilled and merciful.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (4). The Sun, Moon, Mars and Saturn—will suffer from diseases of the eye, will be fond of travels and of prostitutes and will be poor.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars and Saturn in one sign the person will suffer eye disease, be fond of travel and of prostitutes, and be poor.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (5). The Sun, Moon, Mercury and Jupiter—will have eight sons, will be rich and possessed of good qualities; will be famous, powerful and liberal in gift.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mercury and Jupiter in one sign the person will have eight sons and be rich, good, famous, powerful and generous.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (6). The Sun, Moon, Mercury and Venus—will be of defective organs and of good speech.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mercury and Venus in one sign the person will have defective organs and speak well.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (7). The Sun, Moon, Mercury and Saturn—will be poor and ungrateful.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mercury and Saturn in one sign the person will be poor and ungrateful.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (8). The Sun, Moon, Jupiter and Venus—will be possessed of many good qualities, will commit adultery with other women, will be intelligent and will suffer from diseases of the eye.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will have many good qualities, commit adultery, be intelligent, and suffer eye disease.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (9). The Sun, Moon, Jupiter and Saturn—will be fond of travels, will be rich, intelligent and attached to [multiple illicit relationships].
passages.printedText: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (9). The Sun, Moon, Jupiter and Saturn—will be fond of travels, will be rich, intelligent and attached to prostitutes.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be fond of travel, rich, intelligent, and attached to prostitutes.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (10). The Sun, Moon, Venus and Saturn—will be of defective limbs, will be timid, will follow girls and will be fond of wealth and meals.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will have defective limbs, be timid, chase girls, and be fond of wealth and food.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (11). The Sun, Mars, Mercury and Jupiter—will be strong, will get into difficulties, will be married and rich, will suffer from diseases of the eye and will be fond of travels.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Mercury and Jupiter in one sign the person will be strong, meet difficulties, be married and rich, suffer eye disease, and be fond of travel.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (12). The Sun, Mars, Mercury and Venus—will be fond of the wives of other men, will be of fearful eyes and appearance, will be addicted to thieving and will be weak.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Mercury and Venus in one sign the person will desire other men's wives, look fearsome, be given to theft, and be weak.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (13). The Sun, Mars, Mercury and Saturn—will be a commander of armies or a minister, will be addicted to low deeds and will be in the enjoyment of numerous pleasures.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Mercury and Saturn in one sign the person will be an army commander or minister, given to low deeds, and enjoy many pleasures.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (14). The Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Venus—will be as famous as the king, will be respected everywhere and will be rich.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be as famous as a king, respected everywhere, and rich.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (15). The Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn—will be blind, will be a wanderer and will have friends and kinsmen.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be blind, a wanderer, and have friends and kin.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (16). The Sun, Mars, Venus and Saturn—will suffer disgrace, will be slothful and possessed of good qualities.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will suffer disgrace, be slothful, and have good qualities.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (17). The Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus—will be very rich and famous.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be very rich and famous.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (18). The Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn—will bring about quarrels, will be respectable and of vicious habits.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will stir up quarrels, be respectable, and have vicious habits.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (19). The Sun, Mercury, Venus and Saturn—will be of good speech, will be truthful, will be a man of principle and will be of good conduct.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mercury, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will speak well and be truthful, principled and of good conduct.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (20). The Sun, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be learned in arts, will be the chief of low people and will be obstinate.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be learned in the arts, be a chief of low people, and be obstinate.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (21). The Moon, Mars, Mercury and Jupiter—will be liked by the king, will be a minister or an eminent poet.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Jupiter in one sign the person will be liked by the king and be a minister or an eminent poet.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (22). The Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus—will have a good wife and sons, will be intelligent, will be ugly and deformed and will live in comfort.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus in one sign the person will have a good wife and sons, be intelligent, be ugly and deformed, and live in comfort.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (23). The Moon, Mars, Mercury and Saturn—will have double parents, will be bold and will have several wives and children.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Saturn in one sign the person will have two sets of parents, be bold, and have several wives and children.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (24). The Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Venus—will do sinful deeds will indulge in sleep and will be fond of money.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will do sinful deeds, sleep a great deal, and be fond of money.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (25). The Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn—will be of firm views, bold, happy and learned.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will hold firm views and be bold, happy and learned.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (26). The Moon, Mars, Venus and Saturn—will be of bad conduct, will have no sons, will be learned in the Vedas or will be the king's priest.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be of bad conduct, have no sons, and be learned in the Vedas or the king's priest.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (27). The Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus—will be very rich, attached to his kinsmen and virtuous.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be very rich, attached to his kin, and virtuous.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (28). The Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn—will be liberal in gifts, will be respected by the king will live in great comfort, will be wealthy and attached to his wife.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be generous, respected by the king, comfortable, wealthy, and attached to his wife.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (29). The Moon, Mercury, Venus and Saturn—will be hated by the people and will be fond of the wives of other men.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mercury, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be hated by people and desire other men's wives.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (30). The Moon, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be without sons, will not be earnest in work and will be without mercy.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will have no sons, not be earnest in work, and be merciless.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (31). Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus—will be rich and despised by the people
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be rich and despised by people.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (32). Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn—will suffer from diseases and will be poor.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will suffer diseases and be poor.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (33). Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn—will be of defective limbs, will serve under other men, will tell lies and will have bad sons.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will have defective limbs, serve others, tell lies, and have bad sons.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (34). Mars, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be liked by the king, will be of thin body, will have bad sons and will be of clear understanding.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be liked by the king, thin, have bad sons, and have clear understanding.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (35). Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be very rich, learned, and of good conduct.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be very rich, learned, and of good conduct.

passages.text: IV. OF FIVE PLANETS. Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be (1). The Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury and Jupiter—the person will engage in fight, will be deceitful and skilled in work.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury and Jupiter in one sign the person will engage in fights, be deceitful, and be skilled in work.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (2). The Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus—will be devoid of charity, will be earnest in work, will be without kinsmen and will work for other men.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus in one sign the person will be uncharitable, earnest in work, without kin, and work for others.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (3). The Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury and Saturn—will be of short life, will be fond of earning money and without wife and children.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury and Saturn in one sign the person will be short-lived, fond of earning money, and without wife and children.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (4). The Sun, Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Venus—will delight in annoying other men, will be rejected by his parents and kinsmen and will be of defective eyes.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will enjoy annoying others, be rejected by parents and kin, and have defective eyes.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (5). The Sun, Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn—will be avaricious and will be afflicted with grief owing to separation from his wife.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be greedy and grieve over separation from his wife.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (6). The Sun, Moon, Mars, Venus and Saturn—will be wealthy, powerful, able and dirty and will covet the wives of other men.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mars, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be wealthy, powerful, able and dirty, and will covet other men's wives.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (7). The Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus—will be a minister, will be rich, successful, famous and powerful and will also be a magistrate.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be a minister and magistrate, rich, successful, famous and powerful.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (8). The Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn—will depend on other men for meals, will be timid, will commit sins and will engage in fearful deeds.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will depend on others for food, be timid, commit sins, and do fearful deeds.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (9). The Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus and Saturn—will be poor, tall, without sons and sickly.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be poor, tall, without sons, and sickly.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (10). The Sun, Moon, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be without a wife, of good speech, will have enemies will be fearless and learned in jugglery.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Moon, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be without a wife, well spoken, have enemies, be fearless, and be learned in jugglery.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (11). The Sun, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus—will be without grief, a good friend and master of horses and covet the wives of other men.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be free of grief, a good friend, a master of horses, and will covet other men's wives.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (12). The Sun, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn—will beg his meals, will be dirty and dressed in ragged clothes.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will beg for food, be dirty, and wear ragged clothes.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (13). The Sun, Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn—will be an important person and will be afflicted with grief, fear, disease and hunger.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be important but suffer grief, fear, disease and hunger.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (14). The Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be respected everywhere, will be rich, will be blind and will have friends and kinsmen.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be respected everywhere, rich, blind, and have friends and kin.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (15). The Sun, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will possess a knowledge of Atma, will do deeds acceptable to Devas and to his preceptors and will be learned in sciences.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Sun, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will know the Self (Atma), do deeds pleasing to the gods and his teachers, and be learned in the sciences.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (16). The Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus—will be of a mild disposition, happy, rich, powerful and learned.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus in one sign the person will be mild, happy, rich, powerful and learned.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (17). The Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn—will be skilled in engineering, will be of strong physique and will be famous for his skill in work.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter and Saturn in one sign the person will be skilled in engineering, physically strong, and famous for his skill.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (18). The Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn—will have a good wife and sons, will be intelligent and will live in comfort.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will have a good wife and sons, be intelligent, and live in comfort.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (19). The Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will work for other men, will be poor, of dirty appearance, ignorant and addicted to thieving.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will work for others, be poor, dirty, ignorant, and given to theft.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (20). The Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be respected in all lands, will be of defective limbs, will be a minister and will resemble a king.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with the Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be respected everywhere, have defective limbs, be a minister, and resemble a king.

passages.text: [Again, if the yoga planets occupying together a sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be] (21). Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn—will be respected everywhere, will be skilled in work, will suffer from torture, imprisonment and disease.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn in one sign the person will be respected and skilled but will suffer torture, imprisonment and disease.

passages.text: V.—OF SIX PLANETS. Lastly, if the yoga planets occupying a single sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be the several planets except (1). Saturn—the person will be a writer of scientific works, will dwell in woods and mountains and will be possessed of a wife, sons and wealth.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with all planets except Saturn in one sign the person will write scientific works, live in woods and mountains, and have a wife, sons and wealth.

passages.text: [Lastly, if the yoga planets occupying a single sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be the several planets] (2). Except Venus—will be addicted to thieving, will covet other women, will be despised by his kinsmen, will be without sons, will be a fool and will travel to foreign lands.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with all planets except Venus in one sign the person will be given to theft, covet other women, be despised by kin, have no sons, be foolish, and travel abroad.

passages.text: [Lastly, if the yoga planets occupying a single sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be the several planets] (3). Except Jupiter—will be a man of low birth, will work for other men, will suffer from consumption and will be despised by the people.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with all planets except Jupiter in one sign the person will be of low birth, work for others, suffer from consumption, and be despised.

passages.text: [Lastly, if the yoga planets occupying a single sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be the several planets] (4). Except Mercury—will be a minister, will be possessed of a wife, sons, wealth and comfort and will have a control over his passions.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with all planets except Mercury in one sign the person will be a minister, have a wife, sons, wealth and comfort, and control his passions.

passages.text: [Lastly, if the yoga planets occupying a single sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be the several planets] (5). Except Mars—will suffer from headache, will be mad, will live in places unfrequented by man and will travel to foreign lands.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with all planets except Mars in one sign the person will suffer headaches, be mad, live in deserted places, and travel abroad.

passages.text: [Lastly, if the yoga planets occupying a single sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be the several planets] (6). Except the Moon—will be an energetic traveller and intelligent.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with all planets except the Moon in one sign the person will be an energetic traveller and intelligent.

passages.text: [Lastly, if the yoga planets occupying a single sign of Zodiac at the time of birth be the several planets] (7). Except the Sun—will visit holy places, and will be rich.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that with all planets except the Sun in one sign the person will visit holy places and be rich.

passages.text: 1. A person born when four or more (a) powerful (b) planets occupy a single sign of the Zodiac becomes an ascetic of the Sakya, Ajivika, Bhikshuka, Vridhasravaka, Chakra, Nirgrandha or Vanyasana class according as the most powerful planet of the group is Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, the Moon, Venus, Saturn or the Sun. (c) If such powerful planet be one that has suffered defeat in conjunction at the time of birth, the ascetic will, after a time revert to his previous condition of life.
passages.notes:
(a). That is 5, 6 or 7 planets.
(b). If no planet be powerful there will be no Pravrijia (ascetic yoga).
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when four or more powerful planets share one sign becomes an ascetic, the order depending on which planet of the group is strongest: Sakya for Mars, Ajivika for Mercury, Bhikshuka for Jupiter, Vridhasravaka for the Moon, Chakra for Venus, Nirgrandha for Saturn and Vanyasana for the Sun. If that strongest planet was defeated in a planetary conjunction, the person will later return to his former way of life.

passages.text:
(c). The ascetic life of the most powerful planet will be embraced by the person first, then that of the planet next in power and so on. The first change of life will occur in the Dasa and Antardasa period of the most powerful planet ; the succeeding changes will occur in the Antardasa periods of the respective planets. If the yoga planet be a single powerful planet which does not suffer defeat in conjunction, the ascetic life assumed will continue till death. We shall now explain the terms referring to the several classes of ascetics.
(1). Sakya :— A Budhist ascetic dressed in red robes.
(2). Ajivika :— A Jain ascetic; the term includes Vaishnava ascetics as well.
(3). Bhikshu :— A Brahman ascetic who abandons his house and family and subsists entirely on alms.
(4). Vridhasravka :— known as kapalika, a follower of Siva.
(5). Chakra :— known as Chakradhara, is an ascetic who wears a discus.
(6). Nirgrandha :— a naked ascetic.
(7). Vanyasana :— an ascetic who subsists on the roots of the forest and is engaged in Divine meditation.
passages.summary: The translator's note says the person first takes up the ascetic life of the strongest planet, then that of the next strongest, and so on, with the first change in the Dasa and Antardasa period of the strongest planet and later changes in the Antardasa periods of the others. If the yoga planet is a single strong planet not defeated in conjunction, the ascetic life lasts until death. The note then describes each of the seven classes of ascetics.

passages.text: 2. If the most powerful yoga planet be an Astangata planet, (a) a person will not become a Deekshita (b) but will be attached to persons who are such.
passages.notes:
(a). This has already been explained.
(b). That is, one of the holy order of men.
passages.summary: The text says that if the strongest planet of the ascetic yoga is an Astangata (combust) planet, the person will not join a holy order but will be attached to people who belong to one.

passages.text: Again, if the powerful planet which suffers defeat in conjunction be aspected by other planets, a person will not become a Deekshita (c) but will possess a strong desire to become one.
passages.notes: (c). If not aspected, he will become one, and after a time revert to his former condition of life as stated in the last stanza.
passages.summary: The text says that if the strong planet that is defeated in conjunction is aspected by other planets, the person will not join a holy order but will strongly wish to.

passages.text: 3. If the lord of the sign occupied by the Moon aspects Saturn and be not aspected by any other planet, (a) or if Saturn aspect the lord of the sign occupied by the Moon when such lord is not powerful, (b) a person will become an ascetic.
passages.notes:
(a). The Pravrijia will be that of such lord or Saturn whichever is powerful.
(b). The Pravrijia will be that of Saturn.
passages.summary: The text says a person becomes an ascetic if the lord of the Moon's sign aspects Saturn and is aspected by no other planet, or if Saturn aspects the lord of the Moon's sign when that lord is weak.

passages.text: Again, if the Moon occupy the Drekkana of Saturn and the Navamsa of Saturn or Mars and be aspected by Saturn, (c) a person will become an ascetic (d).
passages.notes:
(c). And not aspected by any other planet.
(d). The ascetic life will be that described for Saturn.
passages.summary: The text says a person becomes an ascetic if the Moon is in a Drekkana of Saturn and a Navamsa of Saturn or Mars and is aspected by Saturn.

passages.text: 4. A person born when Jupiter, the Moon and the rising sign are aspected by Saturn, when Jupiter occupies the 9th house from the ascendant and under one of the Raja yogas becomes a scientific author, (a).
passages.summary: The text says a person born when Saturn aspects Jupiter, the Moon and the rising sign, with Jupiter in the 9th house and one of the Raja yogas present, becomes a scientific author.

passages.text: Again, a person born when Saturn occupies the 9th house from the ascendant and is not aspected by other planets and under a Raja yoga will become both a king and an ascetic. (b).
passages.summary: The text says a person born when Saturn is in the 9th house unaspected by other planets, with a Raja yoga present, will become both a king and an ascetic.

passages.text: (a). If the horoscope contain a Raja yoga and an ascetic yoga, the former will not take effect, but the latter will; such for instance as the lives of Varaha Mihira, Kanada, Budha, Panchasikha, Brahma Gupta and others. If the horoscope contain two Raja yogas and an ascetic yoga, the person will become a king — such as Janaka, Kasiraja, Suchidhwaja and others.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that when a horoscope has one Raja yoga and an ascetic yoga, the ascetic yoga takes effect instead of the Raja yoga, citing Varaha Mihira, Kanada, Budha, Panchasikha and Brahma Gupta. With two Raja yogas and an ascetic yoga, the person becomes a king, as with Janaka, Kasiraja and Suchidhwaja.

passages.text: (b). If the horoscope contain no Raja yogas but only the ascetic yoga described in the text, the person will become an ascetic.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if the horoscope has no Raja yoga but only the ascetic yoga described in the verse, the person becomes an ascetic.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Aries will have round red-eyes, will be fond of vegetable food and will eat hot meals but in a moderate degree; will be of a quickly relenting nature, will be fond of travels and of sexual union; will be of strong knees;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aries will have round red eyes, like vegetable food and hot meals in moderation, relent quickly, enjoy travel and sexual union, and have strong knees.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aries] will possess no permanent wealth;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aries will have no lasting wealth.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aries] will be fond of fight and of women; will be skilled in befriending other men;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aries will be fond of fighting and of women, and skilled at making friends.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aries] will have disfigured nails and a wounded head;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aries will have disfigured nails and a wound on the head.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aries] will be haughty; will be the eldest of his brothers;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aries will be haughty and the eldest of his brothers.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aries] will have lines in his hand of the shape of the weapon known as Sakti; will be fickle-minded and will be afraid of water.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aries will have lines on the hand shaped like the Sakti weapon, will be fickle-minded and afraid of water.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Taurus will be of fine appearance and of beautiful gait; will possess large thighs and face; will possess marks on his back, face and sides,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Taurus will look fine, walk beautifully, have large thighs and face, and have marks on the back, face and sides.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Taurus] will be liberal in his gifts; will bear misfortunes; will possess great influence and authority;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Taurus will be generous, will endure misfortunes, and will have great influence and authority.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Taurus] will have a large hump on the neck;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Taurus will have a large hump on the neck.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Taurus] will have daughters;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Taurus will have daughters.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Taurus] will suffer from phlegmatic affections,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Taurus will suffer from phlegm-related complaints.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Taurus] will be separated from his kinsmen, wealth and sons;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Taurus will be separated from his relatives, wealth and sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Taurus] will be of agreeable manners and of patient nature; will be a great eater; will be fond of women; will be attached to his friends and will be happy both when young and old.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Taurus will be pleasant and patient, eat a lot, be fond of women, be loyal to friends, and be happy in youth and old age.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Gemini will be fond of women, will be skilled in sexual union; will possess red eyes;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Gemini will be fond of women, skilled in sexual union, and have red eyes.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Gemini] will be learned in the Sastras; will carry messages;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Gemini will be learned in the sacred sciences and will carry messages.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Gemini] will possess curling hairs and a sharp intellect; will be skilled in wit, in discovering the thoughts of other men and in game;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Gemini will have curly hair and a sharp mind, and be skilled in wit, reading others' thoughts and games.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Gemini] will possess beautiful features; will be of sweet speech; will be a great eater;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Gemini will have beautiful features, speak sweetly and eat a lot.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Gemini] will be fond of music and skilled in the rules of dance;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Gemini will love music and be skilled in dance.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Gemini] will join in sexual union with hermaphrodites; and will possess an elevated nose.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Gemini will have sexual relations with hermaphrodites and will have a raised nose.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Cancer will possess a bent body;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Cancer will have a bent body.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Cancer] will walk fast; will have a high hip;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Cancer will walk fast and have a high hip.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Cancer] will be subject to the influence of women; will have an excellent friend;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Cancer will be influenced by women and will have an excellent friend.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Cancer] will be learned in Astrology;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Cancer will be learned in astrology.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Cancer] will have numerous houses, will have a wealth which will increase and decrease as the Moon;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Cancer will have many houses and wealth that waxes and wanes like the Moon.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Cancer] will be short; will possess a thick neck; will be capable of being won over by kind words, will be attached to his friends and will be fond of water and forests.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Cancer will be short with a thick neck, easily won over by kind words, loyal to friends, and fond of water and forests.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Leo will be of irascible temper, of large cheeks, broad face and brown eyes;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Leo will be quick-tempered, with large cheeks, a broad face and brown eyes.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Leo] will have very few sons;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Leo will have very few sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Leo] will hate women; will be fond of animal food, forests and hills; will continue angry at trifles for a long time;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Leo will dislike women, like meat, forests and hills, and stay angry over small things for a long time.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Leo] will be afflicted with pains caused by hunger, thirst, belly-ache, tooth-ache as well as purely mental anxieties;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Leo will suffer pains from hunger, thirst, belly-ache, tooth-ache and mental anxieties.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Leo] will be liberal in his gifts; will be bold in fight; will be of fixed principles; will be haughty and attached to his mother.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Leo will be generous, bold in battle, firm in principle, haughty and devoted to his mother.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Virgo will, out of modesty, be of mild and beautiful eyes and gait; will have his shoulders and arms sunk or depressed;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Virgo will, from modesty, have gentle beautiful eyes and gait, and sloping shoulders and arms.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Virgo] will live in comfort,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Virgo will live in comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Virgo] will be of soft body; will be truthful,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Virgo will have a soft body and be truthful.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Virgo] will be skilled in dance, music and painting; will be learned in the Sastras;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Virgo will be skilled in dance, music and painting and learned in the sacred sciences.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Virgo] will be virtuous and intelligent, will be fond of sexual union;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Virgo will be virtuous, intelligent and fond of sexual union.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Virgo] will enjoy the house and property of other men; will live in foreign lands;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Virgo will enjoy other people's houses and property and live in foreign lands.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Virgo] will be of sweet speech; and will have daughters and very few sons.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Virgo will speak sweetly and will have daughters and very few sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Libra will respect the Devas, [people of very high status and influence], and holy men; will be intelligent, will never covet the property of other men; will lead a religious life;
passages.printedText: A person born with the Moon in sign Libra will respect the Devas, Brahmins, and holy men; will be intelligent, will never covet the property of other men; will lead a religious life;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Libra will respect gods, Brahmins and holy men, be intelligent, never covet others' property, and lead a religious life.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Libra] will be subject to the influence of women;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Libra will be influenced by women.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Libra] will be tall; will have a raised nose;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Libra will be tall with a raised nose.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Libra] will be of thin and defective limbs and fond of travels;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Libra will have thin, defective limbs and be fond of travel.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Libra] will be rich; will be a trader;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Libra will be rich and a trader.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Libra] will bear the name of a Deva coupled with an excellent surname granted by a body of learned men;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Libra will bear a god's name along with an honorific title granted by learned men.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Libra] will be sickly;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Libra will be sickly.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Libra] will protect his family and will be disgraced and rejected by his kinsmen.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Libra will protect his family but be disgraced and rejected by his relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Scorpio will have broad eyes, a broad breast and round shanks, thighs and knees;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Scorpio will have broad eyes, a broad chest and rounded shins, thighs and knees.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Scorpio] will be separated from his parents and preceptors;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Scorpio will be separated from his parents and teachers.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Scorpio] will be afflicted with diseases when young;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Scorpio will suffer from diseases in youth.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Scorpio] will be respected by kings,
