passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Scorpio will be respected by kings.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Scorpio] will of brown color; will not be of a straight-forward nature; will have lines in his hand and feet of the shape of the fish, the Vajrayudha or a bird; and will endeavor to conceal his sins.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Scorpio will be brown in colour, not straightforward, have lines on hands and feet shaped like a fish, the thunderbolt weapon or a bird, and will try to hide his sins.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Sagittarius will have a long face and neck;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Sagittarius will have a long face and neck.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Sagittarius] will inherit his father's property; will be liberal in his gift;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Sagittarius will inherit his father's property and be generous.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Sagittarius] will be a literary author; will be powerful and skilled in speech;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Sagittarius will be an author, powerful and skilled in speech.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Sagittarius] will have large teeth, ears, lips and nose,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Sagittarius will have large teeth, ears, lips and nose.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Sagittarius] will engage in numerous works; will be skilled in sculpture;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Sagittarius will undertake many works and be skilled in sculpture.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Sagittarius] will have indistinct shoulders, disfigured nails and large hands;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Sagittarius will have indistinct shoulders, disfigured nails and large hands.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Sagittarius] will be of a deep and inventive intellect, will be a man of right understanding; will hate his kinsmen; will never yield to compulsion but only to kind treatment.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Sagittarius will have a deep, inventive mind and sound understanding, will dislike his relatives, and will yield only to kindness, never to force.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn will be ever attached to his wife and children;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Capricorn will always be devoted to his wife and children.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn] will do deeds of virtue;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Capricorn will do virtuous deeds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn] will have thin lower limbs, good eyes and a thin waist;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Capricorn will have thin lower limbs, good eyes and a thin waist.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn] will be open to advice; will be of amiable manners and slow at work; will not bear cold;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Capricorn will take advice, be amiable, work slowly and not tolerate cold.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn] will be of a wandering nature, powerful and a literary author;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Capricorn will be a wanderer, powerful, and an author.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn] will be a niggard
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Capricorn will be a miser.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn] and will be attached to old women of low caste;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Capricorn will be attached to old women of low caste.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Capricorn] will be shameless and merciless.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Capricorn will be shameless and merciless.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius will have a neck like that of the Camel, a body covered with muscles, rough and covered with hair; will be tall; will have large legs, thighs, back, buttocks, face, and lower belly;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aquarius will have a camel-like neck, a muscular, rough and hairy body, be tall, and have large legs, thighs, back, buttocks, face and lower belly.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius] will be deaf;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aquarius will be deaf.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius] will be attached to the wives of other men and interested in the wicked deeds of other people;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aquarius will be attached to other men's wives and interested in other people's wicked deeds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius] will rise and fall by turns;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aquarius will rise and fall in fortune by turns.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius] will be fond of flowers and perfumes; and will be attached to friends and will walk without feeling tired.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Aquarius will love flowers and perfumes, be loyal to friends, and walk without tiring.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Moon in sign Pisces will be a dealer in the produce of the sea and a trader in general;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Pisces will deal in sea produce and be a trader generally.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Pisces] will be fond of his wife and clothes;
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Pisces will be fond of his wife and of clothes.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Pisces] will have perfect limbs, a bright body, long nose and large head,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Pisces will have perfect limbs, a bright body, a long nose and a large head.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with the Moon in sign Pisces] will put his enemies into disgrace, will be subject to the influence of women, will have beautiful eyes, and will be fair, rich, happy and learned.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Moon in Pisces will disgrace his enemies, be influenced by women, have beautiful eyes, and be fair, rich, happy and learned.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person, the Moon, the sign occupied by the Moon and the lord of such sign be all powerful the effects described in this chapter will fully come to pass (a); the same remark applies to planets other than the Moon (b).
passages.notes: (b). This refers to the next chapter in which the author describes the effects of the various planets occupying the several signs of zodiac at the time of birth.
passages.summary: The text says the effects described in this chapter come about fully only when the Moon, its sign and that sign's lord are all strong, and that the same rule applies to the other planets.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Moon in the Several Signs
passages.text: (a). If two of the three be powerful, the effects will come to pass imperfectly; if only one of the three be powerful, they will come to pass still more imperfectly and if none of the three be powerful, the effects will fail.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if only two of the three are strong the effects come about partly, if only one is strong they come about even less, and if none is strong they fail.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in Aries but not in its exaltation degree (a) will be of wide-spread fame, able, of wandering habits, possessed of small wealth and will carry weapons.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Aries, but not at its exact exaltation degree, will be widely famous, capable and given to wandering. It says he will have little wealth and will carry weapons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Taurus will deal in cloths, perfumes and other articles, will hate women and will be skilled in music
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Taurus will trade in cloth, perfumes and other goods, will dislike women and will be skilled in music.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: (a). A person born with the Sun in the exaltation degree will be very rich, will remain for ever in a place, will have servants carrying arms, will be of great fame and able.
passages.summary: The translator's note says a person born with the Sun at its exact exaltation degree will be very rich, will stay settled in one place, will have armed servants, and will be famous and capable.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Gemini will be learned in grammar, will be an Astrologer and will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Gemini will be learned in grammar, will be an astrologer and will be rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in Cancer will be independent, fierce, poor, will do the work of other people and will suffer from the fatigue of foot-journey.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Cancer will be independent, fierce and poor, will work for others and will tire from journeys on foot.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Leo will be fond of living in forests, mountains and cow-sheds, will be powerful and will be a fool.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Leo will like living in forests, mountains and cow-sheds, will be powerful and will be foolish.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Virgo will be skilled in writing, painting, in literary productions and in mathematics, and will possess a body resembling that of a woman.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Virgo will be skilled in writing, painting, literature and mathematics, and will have a body resembling a woman's.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Libra will be fond of liquor or will manufacture it, will be of a wandering nature, will be an alchemist and will do wicked deeds.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Libra will like liquor or make it, will be a wanderer, will be an alchemist and will do wicked deeds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Scorpio will be of a fierce nature, will thoughtlessly engage in work, will earn money by acts connected with poison and will be vastly learned in the use of arms.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Scorpio will be fierce, will take up work without thought, will earn money through dealings with poison and will be highly skilled with weapons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in Sagittari will be respected by sages, will be rich and independent and will be learned in medicine and sculpture.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Sagittarius will be respected by sages, will be rich and independent, and will be learned in medicine and sculpture.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Capricorn will engage in deeds unsuited to his rank in life, will be ignorant, will deal in mean articles, will possess small wealth, will be avaricious and will enjoy the property of other men.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Capricorn will do things unsuited to his station, will be ignorant, will trade in cheap goods, will have little wealth, will be greedy and will enjoy other people's property.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Aquarius will engage in deeds unsuited to his rank in life, will be poor and will have no sons.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Aquarius will do things unsuited to his station, will be poor and will have no sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Pisces will become rich by dealing in the produce of water, will be respected by women, will possess a mole or other marks in the part of body corresponding to the sign occupied by the Sun and Moon together.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with the Sun in Pisces will grow rich by trading in products of the water and will be respected by women. It adds that he will have a mole or other mark on the body part corresponding to the sign the Sun and Moon occupy together.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mars in sign Aries or Scorpio will be respected by the king, will be of a wandering nature, will be a commander of armies or a trader, will be rich,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Aries or Scorpio will be respected by the king, will be a wanderer, will be an army commander or a trader, and will be rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Mars in sign Aries or Scorpio] will have a body marked with wounds, will be a thief
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Aries or Scorpio will have a body marked with wounds and will be a thief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Mars in sign Aries or Scorpio] and will be in the enjoyment of the pleasures of the senses.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Aries or Scorpio will enjoy the pleasures of the senses.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mars in sign Taurus or Libra will be subject to the influence of women, will not be open to the advice of friends, will be fond of the wives of other men, will be learned in the games of magic, will adorn his person, will be of a timid nature and will have a rough body.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Taurus or Libra will be swayed by women, will ignore friends' advice, will desire other men's wives, will know magic tricks, will adorn himself, will be timid and will have a rough body.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mars in sign Gemini or Virgo will be of bright appearance, will have sons and no friends, will help others, will be skilled in music and fight, will be a niggard, and will be fearless and of a begging nature.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Gemini or Virgo will look bright, will have sons but no friends, will help others, will be skilled in music and fighting, will be stingy, fearless and inclined to beg.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mars in sign Cancer will be rich, will cross seas and earn wealth,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Cancer will be rich and will cross the seas to earn wealth.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Mars in sign Cancer] will be of defective limbs and will be wicked.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Cancer will have defective limbs and will be wicked.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mars in sign Leo will be poor, will patiently bear afflictions, will wander in the forests, will be fearless and will have few wives and children.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Leo will be poor, will bear hardship patiently, will wander in forests, will be fearless and will have few wives and children.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mars in sign Sagittari or Pisces will have many enemies, will be the king's minister, will be of wide-spread fame, will be fearless and will have very few children.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Sagittarius or Pisces will have many enemies, will be the king's minister, will be widely famous, will be fearless and will have very few children.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mars in sign Aquarius will ever suffer grief, will be poor, will wander from place to place, will be a liar, will be independent and wicked.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Aquarius will always suffer grief, will be poor, will wander from place to place, will lie, and will be independent and wicked.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mars in sign Capricorn will be very rich, will have many sons and will be a king or will resemble a king.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mars in Capricorn will be very rich, will have many sons and will be a king or like a king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Aries or Scorpio will be fond of gambling, of running into debt and of liquor; will be an atheist, will argue against the spirit of the Sastras,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Aries or Scorpio will be fond of gambling, debt and liquor, will be an atheist and will argue against the scriptures.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Mercury in sign Aries or Scorpio] will be a thief,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Aries or Scorpio will be a thief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Mercury in sign Aries or Scorpio] will be poor, will have a mean wife,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Aries or Scorpio will be poor and will have a mean wife.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Mercury in sign Aries or Scorpio] will be deceitful, will be a liar and will swerve from the path of rectitude.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Aries or Scorpio will be deceitful, will lie and will stray from upright conduct.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Taurus or Libra will be a preacher, will have many sons and wives, will ever be engaged in earning money, will be liberal in gift and will respect his preceptor.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Taurus or Libra will be a preacher, will have many sons and wives, will always be busy earning money, will be generous and will respect his teacher.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Gemini will be talkative, will be a liar will be learned in the sciences, in music, in dance and in painting; will be of sweet speech and will live in comfort.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Gemini will be talkative and a liar, will be learned in the sciences, music, dance and painting, will speak sweetly and will live in comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Cancer will earn money by works connected with water and will be disliked by his kinsmen.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Cancer will earn money through work connected with water and will be disliked by his relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Leo will be disliked by women, will be poor, will have neither comfort nor sons, will wander from place to place, will be ignorant, will be fond of women and will suffer disgrace.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Leo will be disliked by women, poor, without comfort or sons, a wanderer, ignorant, fond of women, and will suffer disgrace.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Virgo will be liberal in gift, will be learned, will possess many virtues, will live in comfort, will be of a patient nature, will be ingenious and fearless.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Virgo will be generous, learned, virtuous, comfortable, patient, ingenious and fearless.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Capricorn or Aquarius will work for other men, will be poor, will be a sculptor, will run into debts and will work for no fees.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Capricorn or Aquarius will work for others, will be poor, will be a sculptor, will fall into debt and will work without pay.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Sagittari will be respected by kings, will be learned in sciences and in laws.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Sagittarius will be respected by kings and learned in the sciences and the law.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Mercury in sign Pisces will be skilled in befriending other men, will readily discover the views of other people,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Pisces will be good at making friends and quick to understand other people's views.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Mercury in sign Pisces] and will be learned in the handicraft of men of low castes.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Mercury in Pisces will be skilled in crafts it associates with particular castes.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Aries or Scorpio will be a commander of armies, will be very rich, will have many wives and children, will be liberal in gift, will have good servants, will be of a patient nature, and of bright appearance, will be happy with his wife and will be of great fame.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Jupiter in Aries or Scorpio will command armies, be very rich, have many wives and children, be generous, have good servants, be patient and bright-looking, be happy with his wife and be very famous.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Taurus or Libra will be free from diseases, will live in comfort, will be rich, will have friends and sons, will be liberal in gift and will be liked by all.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Jupiter in Taurus or Libra will be free from disease, comfortable and rich, will have friends and sons, will be generous and liked by all.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Gemini or Virgo will have many clothes, houses, servants, sons and friends, will be a minister and will live in comfort.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Jupiter in Gemini or Virgo will have many clothes, houses, servants, sons and friends, will be a minister and will live in comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Cancer will be possessed of gems, sons, wealth, wives, influence, intelligence and comfort.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Jupiter in Cancer will have gems, sons, wealth, wives, influence, intelligence and comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Leo will be all that has been said in the case of a person born with Jupiter in Cancer and will besides be a commander of armies.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Jupiter in Leo will have all the results given for Jupiter in Cancer and will also command armies.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Sagittari or Pisces will be the ruler of a province or a minister under a king or the commander of armies or will be very rich.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Jupiter in Sagittarius or Pisces will be a provincial ruler, a king's minister, an army commander, or very rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Aquarius will be all that has been said in the case of a person born with the Moon in sign Cancer.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Jupiter in Aquarius will have all the results given for a person born with the Moon in Cancer.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Jupiter in sign Capricorn will do deeds disgraceful to his rank in life, will possess very little wealth and will be afflicted with grief.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Jupiter in Capricorn will do things disgraceful to his station, will have very little wealth and will suffer grief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Aries or Scorpio will be fond of the wives of other men, will lose his property through their influence and will bring disgrace on his family.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Aries or Scorpio will desire other men's wives, will lose his property because of them and will bring disgrace on his family.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Taurus or Libra will acquire wealth by his own powers, will be liked by the king, will be an important person among his kinsmen, will be a man of fame and will be fearless.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Taurus or Libra will earn wealth by his own efforts, be liked by the king, be important among his relatives, be famous and be fearless.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Gemini will do the work of a king, will be rich and learned in music.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Gemini will do a king's work, will be rich and will be learned in music.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Virgo will engage in hard work.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Virgo will do hard work.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Capricorn or Aquarius will be liked by all, will be subject to the influence of women
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Capricorn or Aquarius will be liked by all and will be swayed by women.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Venus in sign Capricorn or Aquarius] and will be fond of [multiple illicit relationships].
passages.printedText: [A person born with Venus in sign Capricorn or Aquarius] and will be fond of bad women.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Capricorn or Aquarius will be attracted to women whose conduct the text disapproves of.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Cancer will have two wives, will be a beggar, will be timid and haughty and will suffer grief
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Cancer will have two wives, will beg, will be timid and haughty, and will suffer grief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Leo will acquire money through women, will have an excellent wife and very few sons.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Leo will gain money through women, will have an excellent wife and very few sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Sagittari will be possessed of excellent qualities and will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Sagittarius will have excellent qualities and will be rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Venus in sign Pisces will be learned, will be a man of authority, will be rich, will be respected by the king and will be liked by all.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Venus in Pisces will be learned, will hold authority, will be rich, respected by the king and liked by all.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Aries will be a fool, will wander from place to place, will be a fop and will be separated from his friends.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Aries will be foolish, will wander from place to place, will be a fop and will be separated from his friends.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Scorpio will suffer imprisonment, will receive blows,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Scorpio will be imprisoned and will be beaten.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Scorpio] will be indifferent to work and will be merciless.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Scorpio will be indifferent to work and merciless.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Gemini or Virgo will be shameless, will suffer grief, will be poor, will have no sons, will be a bad painter, will be a constable and will be a chief officer.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Gemini or Virgo will be shameless, grieving and poor, will have no sons, will be a poor painter, and will be a constable and a chief officer.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Taurus will be fond of women of low caste,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Taurus will be fond of women of a caste it ranks low.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Taurus] will possess small wealth and will have several wives.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Taurus will have little wealth and several wives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Libra, will be the chief of a party of men in a town or in an army or in a village and will be rich.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Libra will lead a group of men in a town, an army or a village and will be rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Cancer will be poor,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Cancer will be poor.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Cancer] will have very few teeth,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Cancer will have very few teeth.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Cancer] will be separated from his mother and will have no sons.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Cancer will be separated from his mother and will have no sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Leo will not be deserving of respect, will suffer grief, will have no sons and will carry burdens.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Leo will not deserve respect, will suffer grief, will have no sons and will carry burdens.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Sagittari or Pisces will die an excellent death,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Sagittarius or Pisces will die an excellent death.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Sagittari or Pisces] will be a faithful officer in the king's palace, will have good sons and a good wife, will be wealthy, will be the chief man in a town, in an army or in a village.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Sagittarius or Pisces will be a faithful officer in the king's palace, will have good sons and a good wife, will be wealthy, and will be the leading man in a town, an army or a village.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: A person born with Saturn in sign Capricorn or Aquarius will enjoy the wives and property of other men, will be the head of a town, a village or an army,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Capricorn or Aquarius will enjoy other men's wives and property and will head a town, a village or an army.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Capricorn or Aquarius] will have weak eyes,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Capricorn or Aquarius will have weak eyes.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Capricorn or Aquarius] will be dirty, will be indifferent to bathing,
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Capricorn or Aquarius will be dirty and will neglect bathing.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born with Saturn in sign Capricorn or Aquarius] will have a permanent wealth and authority and will enjoy the property acquired by him.
passages.summary: The text says a person born with Saturn in Capricorn or Aquarius will have lasting wealth and authority and will enjoy the property he has earned.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: To determine the effects of the planetary places the reader is referred to Stanza 13 and Note (b) to it of the last Chapter.
passages.summary: The translator's note refers the reader to Stanza 13 of the previous chapter and its note for how to determine the effects of planetary positions. It states no results.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: The effects described for the several signs of the zodiac when the Moon occupies them or when they are aspected by planets also apply to the rising sign; nay — more effects are due to the rising sign and to the 2nd, 3rd, and other bhavas (houses). If the houses be powerful and if their lords be also powerful, these effects will come to pass fully.
passages.notes: If the rising sign and its lord be powerful, a person born will be of strong physique; if the 2nd house and its lord be powerful, the person will be rich. Similar remarks apply to the other bhavas. The following have been extracted from Satyachariar's work on Horoscopy.
passages.summary: The text says the effects given for the Moon in each sign, or for signs aspected by planets, also apply to the rising sign, and further effects come from the rising sign and the other houses. It says these effects come about fully when the houses and their lords are powerful.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 1. A person born when Aries is the rising sign will have disfigured fingers,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aries rising will have disfigured fingers.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Aries is the rising sign] will be of irascible temper, will bring on quarrels, will act inconsistently with his views, will be of bilious and windy temperament, will be a niggard, will suffer grief,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aries rising will be quick-tempered and quarrelsome, will act against his own views, will have a bilious and windy constitution, will be stingy and will suffer grief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Aries is the rising sign] will when young, be separated from his parents and from his preceptor, will have very few sons, will assist his brothers and kinsmen,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aries rising will be separated from his parents and teacher when young, will have very few sons and will help his brothers and relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Aries is the rising sign] will be virtuous, will travel to foreign lands, will engage in useless work,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aries rising will be virtuous, will travel abroad and will do useless work.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Aries is the rising sign] will marry either a woman of low caste or a deceitful woman or a woman of defective limbs or one who was already married,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aries rising will marry a woman of a caste it ranks low, a deceitful woman, a woman with defective limbs, or one previously married.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Aries is the rising sign] will obtain as relations persons of a friendly nature
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aries rising will gain friendly people as relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Aries is the rising sign] and will meet his death either by weapons or by poison or by bilious complaints or by the people about him or by fire, by rain, by being shut up in a prison or by fall.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aries rising will die by weapons, poison, bilious illness, the people around him, fire, rain, imprisonment or a fall.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 2. A person born when Taurus is the rising sign will have large lips, cheeks, nose and forehead, will be of phlegmatic and windy temperament,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Taurus rising will have large lips, cheeks, nose and forehead and a phlegmatic and windy constitution.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Taurus is the rising sign] will be liberal in gift, will be a spendthrift,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Taurus rising will be generous and a spendthrift.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Taurus is the rising sign] will have daughters and very few sons,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Taurus rising will have daughters and very few sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Taurus is the rising sign] will ill-treat his parents,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Taurus rising will mistreat his parents.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Taurus is the rising sign] will be fond of work, will do wicked deeds, will earn much wealth,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Taurus rising will love work, will do wicked deeds and will earn much wealth.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Taurus is the rising sign] will ever be fond of his wife
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Taurus rising will always be fond of his wife.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Taurus is the rising sign] and will suffer from weapons. He will meet his death by weapons, ropes or animals, in foreign lands or will die through over work or by water or by a spear or through want of exercise or by quadrupeds.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Taurus rising will be hurt by weapons and will die by weapons, ropes, animals, abroad, through overwork, water, a spear, lack of exercise or four-footed animals.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 3. A person born when the rising sign is Gemini will be either of defective limbs or will possess extra limbs,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Gemini rising will have either defective or extra limbs.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Gemini] will be of sweet speech, will engage in excellent works, will be of a mixed temperament, will be of small understanding and of small body, will be liked by his preceptor and by sages,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Gemini rising will speak sweetly, do excellent work, have a mixed constitution, limited understanding and a small body, and be liked by his teacher and by sages.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Gemini] will have very few younger brothers,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Gemini rising will have very few younger brothers.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Gemini] will not be of very active habits, will put other men to disgrace, will possess good qualities, will be anxious to engage in a number of works, will be virtuous and not wicked,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Gemini rising will not be very active, will put others to shame, will have good qualities, will want to take on many tasks, and will be virtuous rather than wicked.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Gemini] will earn and spend much, will possess several wives and will be free from serious diseases.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Gemini rising will earn and spend much, will have several wives and will be free from serious disease.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Gemini] He will meet his death by snake-bite, poison, animals or by water.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Gemini rising will die by snake-bite, poison, animals or water.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 4. A person born when the rising sign is Cancer will be a man of no fixed principles,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Cancer rising will have no fixed principles.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Cancer] will suffer diseases of genital organs,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Cancer rising will suffer diseases of the genital organs.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Cancer] will be of a timid nature, will be grateful, will be of phlegmatic and windy temperament, will readily understand things, will follow his enemies, will spend the property of other men also, will be haughty among his people, will be put to disgrace by his kinsmen,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Cancer rising will be timid, grateful, of phlegmatic and windy constitution and quick to understand, will follow his enemies, spend others' property, be haughty among his people and be disgraced by his relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Cancer] will lose his children,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Cancer rising will lose his children.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Cancer] will engage in important works in foreign lands,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Cancer rising will do important work abroad.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Cancer] will be of imperfect speech,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Cancer rising will have imperfect speech.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Cancer] will be a master over other men, will have an unequal wife, will suffer disgrace from his enemies and will be respected by many persons.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Cancer rising will have authority over others, will have an ill-matched wife, will be disgraced by enemies and will be respected by many.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Cancer] He will meet his death by means of a neck ornament or a rope, by phlegmatic complaints, by the fracture of bones, by sword cut, or by dropsy.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Cancer rising will die by a neck ornament or rope, phlegmatic illness, broken bones, a sword cut or dropsy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 5. A person born when the rising sign is Leo will be severe, fond of animal food and of bilious temperament, will conceal himself,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Leo rising will be severe, fond of meat, of bilious constitution, and secretive.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Leo] will support his family by engaging in various works, will be a niggard,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Leo rising will support his family through various kinds of work and will be stingy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Leo] will like the people, will be a man of renown and of resignation; will annoy his kinsmen, will be able, and energetic, will be of a sinful nature,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Leo rising will like people, be renowned and resigned, annoy his relatives, be capable and energetic, and be sinful by nature.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Leo] will possess several wives
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Leo rising will have several wives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Leo] and will have a diseased waist, knees and teeth. He will meet his death by weapons, hurtful animals, by poison, by wood, by diseases, by the creatures of water or by starvation.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Leo rising will have diseased waist, knees and teeth and will die by weapons, harmful animals, poison, wood, disease, water creatures or starvation.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 6. A person born when the rising sign is Virgo, will be of sweet speech, of bright personal appearance, long legs and arms, will be of a mixed temperament, will be of excellent beauty,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Virgo rising will speak sweetly, look bright, have long legs and arms, a mixed constitution and excellent beauty.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Virgo] will receive wounds,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Virgo rising will receive wounds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Virgo] will be rich, will be a niggard,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Virgo rising will be rich and stingy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Virgo] will be attached to his kinsmen, will have many daughters, will be in bad terms with his brothers and sisters,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Virgo rising will be attached to his relatives, will have many daughters and will be on bad terms with his brothers and sisters.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Virgo] will be inclined to deeds of virtue, will not earn much, and will be skilled in work.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Virgo rising will be inclined to virtue, will not earn much, and will be skilled at work.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Virgo] He will meet his death by means of quadrupeds, weapons, bilious attacks, grief, fire or rope.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Virgo rising will die by four-footed animals, weapons, bilious attacks, grief, fire or rope.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 7. A person born when Libra is the rising sign will be of a rough body, a harsh nature and a phlegmatic and windy temperament, will thoughtlessly begin a work, will be of short neck, will be grateful,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Libra rising will have a rough body, a harsh nature and a phlegmatic and windy constitution, will start work without thought, will have a short neck and will be grateful.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Libra is the rising sign] will acquire much wealth, will become famous by his acts of liberality,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Libra rising will gain much wealth and become famous for his generosity.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Libra is the rising sign] will serve under his preceptor, will be respected by his father, brothers and others,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Libra rising will serve his teacher and be respected by his father, brothers and others.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Libra is the rising sign] will be fond of walking, will be virtuous, will conceal himself to escape troubles from his kinsmen,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Libra rising will enjoy walking, will be virtuous and will hide himself to avoid trouble from relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Libra is the rising sign] will lose his wife,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Libra rising will lose his wife.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Libra is the rising sign] will be fond of fight and will suffer from grief.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Libra rising will be fond of fighting and will suffer grief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when Libra is the rising sign] He will meet his death by a famous man, by his kinsmen, by mild quadrupeds, by perspiration, by separation from an object of desire and by the fatigue of journey.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Libra rising will die through a famous man, his relatives, gentle four-footed animals, perspiration, separation from something desired or the fatigue of travel.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 8. A person born when the rising sign is Scorpio will have a broad face and a long belly, will be of a harsh nature and of a bilious temperament, will have brown eyes, will be slow and of quick pace,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Scorpio rising will have a broad face, a long belly, a harsh nature, a bilious constitution and brown eyes, and will be slow yet quick-paced.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Scorpio] will be a master over others, will protect a large family, will be hated by his kinsmen, will spend much, will have many children,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Scorpio rising will have authority over others, will support a large family, will be hated by his relatives, will spend much and will have many children.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Scorpio] will not live in comfort, will have no enemies, will lose his virtues, will protect oxen, will fall into bad temper on account of his wife, will yield nothing to his enemies, will have his own men for his enemies,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Scorpio rising will not live in comfort, will have no enemies yet will have his own people as enemies, will lose his virtues, will tend oxen, will be bad-tempered because of his wife and will yield nothing to his enemies.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Scorpio] will suffer from numerous diseases and will surrender himself to his foe out of fear of sword-cut. He will meet his death by imprisonment, blows, sword-cut, bad diseases or by fire.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Scorpio rising will suffer many diseases, will surrender to his enemy for fear of the sword, and will die by imprisonment, blows, sword-cut, serious disease or fire.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 9. A person born when the rising sign is Sagittari will have large lips, teeth and nose, will be of phlegmatic and windy temperament, will have a fleshy genital organ, thighs and arms,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Sagittarius rising will have large lips, teeth and nose, a phlegmatic and windy constitution, and fleshy genitals, thighs and arms.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Sagittari] will be of defective nails,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Sagittarius rising will have defective nails.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Sagittari] will be skilled in work, will be bold in fight,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Sagittarius rising will be skilled at work and bold in battle.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Sagittari] will serve under men of low caste,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Sagittarius rising will serve under men of a caste it ranks low.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Sagittari] will be deprived of his property by thieves, by fire or by the king,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Sagittarius rising will lose his property to thieves, fire or the king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Sagittari] will be learned in laws, will be respected by many people, will give trouble to his brothers, will work in foreign lands, will be liked by the king, will be indifferent to deeds of virtue,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Sagittarius rising will know the law, be respected by many, trouble his brothers, work abroad, be liked by the king and be indifferent to virtuous deeds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Sagittari] will quarrel with his wives
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Sagittarius rising will quarrel with his wives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Sagittari] and will have a diseased face. He will meet his death by quadrupeds, snakes, the king or by imprisonment.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Sagittarius rising will have a diseased face and will die by four-footed animals, snakes, the king or imprisonment.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 10. A person born when the rising sign is Capricorn will have a small nose, long face, arms and legs; will be of windy temperament, of a timid nature, will thoughtlessly engage in work,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Capricorn rising will have a small nose and a long face, arms and legs, a windy constitution and a timid nature, and will take up work without thought.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Capricorn] will suffer imprisonment,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Capricorn rising will be imprisoned.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Capricorn] will have a small family, and small wealth, will be a niggard, will have daughters, will have no kinsmen,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Capricorn rising will have a small family and little wealth, will be stingy, will have daughters and will have no relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Capricorn] will live in plenty, will acquire wealth by his valor, through the king and by forest will observe fasting,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Capricorn rising will live in plenty, will gain wealth through his courage, the king and the forest, and will observe fasts.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Capricorn] will have a wife of low caste, and will be attached to her,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Capricorn rising will have a wife of a caste it ranks low and will be attached to her.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Capricorn] will have a large body, few hairs and weak knees and will suffer from diseases. He will meet his death by children, by the wind, by weapons, by the king, by poison, by fall, by an elephant, by an increase of bile or by dyspepsia.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Capricorn rising will have a large body, little hair and weak knees, will suffer diseases, and will die through children, wind, weapons, the king, poison, a fall, an elephant, excess bile or dyspepsia.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 11. A person born when the rising sign is Aquarius, will be of inactive habits and of harsh nature, will be the eldest in the family, will be of bilious and windy temperament, will have a nose shaped like the flower of the sesamum plant,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aquarius rising will be inactive and harsh, will be the eldest in the family, will have a bilious and windy constitution and a nose shaped like a sesame flower.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Aquarius] will waste his wealth, will have many servants,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aquarius rising will waste his wealth and will have many servants.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Aquarius] will be hated by his kinsmen, preceptors, enemies and friends; will be fond of deeds of wickedness,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aquarius rising will be hated by his relatives, teachers, enemies and friends, and will like wicked deeds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Aquarius] will acquire much property, will never spend money on charity, will assume a show of virtue, will worship the Devas
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aquarius rising will gain much property, will never give to charity, will put on a show of virtue and will worship the gods.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Aquarius] and will suffer from phlegmatic attacks affecting the chest. He will meet his death from pains in the belly by vomition and by drugs administered by women.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Aquarius rising will suffer phlegmatic attacks in the chest and will die of belly pains, vomiting and drugs given by women.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: 12. A person born when the rising sign is Pisces will have thick lips, fish-like eye and large nose, will be of phlegmatic and windy temperament, will be a sage,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Pisces rising will have thick lips, fish-like eyes and a large nose, a phlegmatic and windy constitution, and will be a sage.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Pisces] will be of disfigured skins and of active habits,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Pisces rising will have disfigured skin and active habits.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Pisces] will be remarkable for his gain and loss, will have good servants and kinsmen, will be disposed to deeds of virtue,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Pisces rising will be notable for gains and losses, will have good servants and relatives, and will be inclined to virtue.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Pisces] will have a good wife, will help his father,
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Pisces rising will have a good wife and will help his father.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Sun, Mars and Other Planets in the Several Signs
passages.text: [A person born when the rising sign is Pisces] will join a woman of low deeds
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, a person born with Pisces rising will take up with a woman whose conduct the text disapproves of.

passages.text: As stated in the last Stanza of the last chapter, all that has been said of the Moon applies also to the rising sign. The Moon by aspecting the several signs of the Zodiac except sign Cancer produces malefic effects when such signs are rising signs.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that everything said about the Moon here also applies to the rising sign, and that the Moon aspecting any rising sign other than Cancer produces bad effects.

passages.text: If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the solar or lunar hora of a sign, she will produce benefic effects if she be aspected by planets occupying respectively the solar and lunar horas. (a)
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the solar or lunar hora (half-sign) of a sign and is aspected by planets in the same kind of hora, she produces good effects.

passages.text: If the Moon be aspected by the lord of the Drekkana occupied by her or by planets occupying friendly signs she will produce benefic effects, (b).
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is aspected by the lord of the Drekkana (third of a sign) she occupies, or by planets in friendly signs, she produces good effects.

passages.text: The effects described for the Moon occupying the several signs and aspected by the several planets apply to her when she occupies the several Dwadasamsas and is aspected by the several planets, (c.)
passages.summary: The text says that the results given for the Moon in each sign aspected by each planet also apply when the Moon is in the corresponding Dwadasamsa (twelfth of a sign).

passages.text: If the Moon occupy particular Navamsas and be aspected by the several planets, the effects will be those stated as follows.
passages.summary: The text introduces the results that follow for the Moon in particular Navamsas aspected by the various planets; it states no results itself.

passages.text: (a). If the Moon be aspected by planets occupying horas whose lords are different from the lords of the horas occupied by her the effects will be malefic. The same remarks apply to the rising hora.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if the Moon is aspected by planets in horas ruled by lords different from that of her own hora, the effects are bad, and that the same applies to the rising hora.

passages.text: (b). The same remarks apply to the rising Drekkana.
passages.summary: The translator's note says the Drekkana rule also applies to the rising Drekkana.

passages.text: (c). The same remark holds with reference to the rising Dwadasamsa. If the rising Dwadasamsa be other than that of Cancer, and if the rising sign be aspected by the Moon the effects will be malefic; if the rising Dwadasamsa be that of Cancer, and if the rising sign be aspected by the Moon, the effects will be benefic.
passages.summary: The translator's note says the Dwadasamsa rule also applies to the rising Dwadasamsa: if the Moon aspects the rising sign, the effects are bad unless the rising Dwadasamsa is that of Cancer, in which case they are good.

passages.text: If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mars and be aspected by the Sun, the person will be the protector of a city;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mars and aspected by the Sun, the person will be the protector of a city.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mars] if aspected by Mars, he will be fond of torture;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mars and aspected by Mars, the person will be fond of torture.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mars] if aspected by Mercury he will be skilled in duel fight;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mars and aspected by Mercury, the person will be skilled in duelling.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mars] if by Jupiter, he will be a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mars and aspected by Jupiter, the person will be a king.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mars] if by Venus he will be rich
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mars and aspected by Venus, the person will be rich.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mars] and if by Saturn, he will bring on quarrels.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mars and aspected by Saturn, the person will bring on quarrels.

passages.text: If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Venus and be aspected by the Sun, the person will be a fool;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Venus and aspected by the Sun, the person will be a fool.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Venus] if aspected by Mars, he will be fond of the wives of other men;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Venus and aspected by Mars, the person will be fond of other men's wives.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Venus] if by Mercury or Jupiter he will be produce good literary works;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Venus and aspected by Mercury or Jupiter, the person will produce good literary works.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Venus] if by Venus, he will be fond of comforts;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Venus and aspected by Venus, the person will be fond of comforts.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Venus] if by Saturn, he will unite with the wives of other men.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Venus and aspected by Saturn, the person will have relations with other men's wives.

passages.text: If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mercury and be aspected by the Sun, the person will be a duellist or a dancer;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mercury and aspected by the Sun, the person will be a duellist or a dancer.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mercury] if aspected by Mars he will be a thief;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mercury and aspected by Mars, the person will be a thief.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mercury] if by Mercury he will be a great poet;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mercury and aspected by Mercury, the person will be a great poet.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mercury] if by Jupiter, he will be a minister;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mercury and aspected by Jupiter, the person will be a minister.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mercury] if by Venus, he will be skilled in music
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mercury and aspected by Venus, the person will be skilled in music.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Mercury] and if by Saturn, he will be skilled in mechanical arts.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Mercury and aspected by Saturn, the person will be skilled in mechanical arts.

passages.text: If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Cancer and be aspected by the Sun, the person will be of small body;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Cancer and aspected by the Sun, the person will have a small body.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Cancer] if aspected by Mars, he will be a niggard and will possess small wealth;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Cancer and aspected by Mars, the person will be miserly and will have little wealth.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Cancer] if by Mercury he will practise austerities;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Cancer and aspected by Mercury, the person will practise austerities.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Cancer] if by Jupiter, he will be a chief,
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Cancer and aspected by Jupiter, the person will be a chief.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Cancer] if by Venus, he will thrive by women
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Cancer and aspected by Venus, the person will prosper through women.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Cancer] and if by Saturn, he will be fond of work.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Cancer and aspected by Saturn, the person will be fond of work.

passages.text: If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Leo and be aspected by the Sun, the person will be a man of angry temper;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Leo and aspected by the Sun, the person will have an angry temper.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Leo] if aspected by Mars, he will be liked by the king;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Leo and aspected by Mars, the person will be liked by the king.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Leo] if by Mercury, he will become rich by the discovery of hidden treasure;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Leo and aspected by Mercury, the person will become rich by discovering hidden treasure.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Leo] if by Jupiter, he will carry his orders into effect;
