passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Leo and aspected by Jupiter, the person will see his orders carried out.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Leo] if by Venus, he will have no sons
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Leo and aspected by Venus, the person will have no sons.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Leo] and if by Saturn he will do wicked deeds.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in the Navamsa of Leo and aspected by Saturn, the person will do wicked deeds.

passages.text: If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Jupiter and be aspected by the Sun, the person will be a man of well-known powers;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Jupiter and aspected by the Sun, the person will be a man of well-known powers.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Jupiter] if aspected by Mars, he will be learned in the rules of fight;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Jupiter and aspected by Mars, the person will be learned in the rules of combat.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Jupiter] if by Mercury, he will be skilled in Ridicule;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Jupiter and aspected by Mercury, the person will be skilled in ridicule.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Jupiter] if by Jupiter, he will be a minister;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Jupiter and aspected by Jupiter, the person will be a minister.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Jupiter] if by Venus, he will be a man of no virility
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Jupiter and aspected by Venus, the person will lack virility.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Jupiter] and if by Saturn, he will be charitably disposed.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Jupiter and aspected by Saturn, the person will be charitable.

passages.text: If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Saturn and be aspected by the Sun, the person will have very few children;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Saturn and aspected by the Sun, the person will have very few children.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Saturn] if aspected by Mars, he will be unhappy though rich;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Saturn and aspected by Mars, the person will be unhappy though rich.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Saturn] if by Mercury, he will be haughty;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Saturn and aspected by Mercury, the person will be haughty.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Saturn] if by Jupiter, he will do deeds unsuited to his station in life;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Saturn and aspected by Jupiter, the person will do deeds unsuited to his station in life.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Saturn] if by Venus, he will be fond of [multiple illicit relationships]
passages.printedText: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Saturn] if by Venus, he will be fond of bad women
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Saturn and aspected by Venus, the person will be fond of women of loose sexual conduct.

passages.text: [If at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Saturn] and if by Saturn, he will be a niggard (a).
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Navamsa of Saturn and aspected by Saturn, the person will be miserly.

passages.text: All that has been said for the Moon occupying particular Navamsas and aspected by the several planets applies also to the Sun—with this exception that where solar aspect has been referred to, it shall be read as lunar aspect.
passages.summary: The text says that the results given for the Moon in particular Navamsas aspected by the planets also apply to the Sun, with the Moon's aspect taking the place of the Sun's aspect.

passages.text: (a). The same remark applies to the rising Navamsa as to the Moon — but if the Moon aspect the rising sign when the rising Navamsa is other than that of Cancer the effects will be malefic.
passages.summary: The translator's note says the Navamsa results also apply to the rising Navamsa, but if the Moon aspects the rising sign when the rising Navamsa is not that of Cancer, the effects will be bad.

passages.text: If the Moon occupy a Vargottama position, her own Navamsa, or other Navamsas and be aspected by benefic planets, the effects will respectively be full, imperfect and small. But if she be aspected by malefic planets, the effects will respectively be small, imperfect and full (a).
passages.summary: The text says that when benefics aspect the Moon, the effects are full if she is Vargottama, partial in her own Navamsa and small in other Navamsas; when malefics aspect her, the effects are small, partial and full respectively. It describes the strength of effects rather than specific results.

passages.text: If the lord of the Navamsa be powerful, the effects described for planetary aspects in the case of signs and Navamsas (b) will alone come to pass (c.)
passages.notes: (b). Navamsas occupied by the Sun or the Moon or the rising Navamsa. (c). And those described for planetary aspects in the case of horas, Drekkanas and Dwadasamsas.
passages.summary: The text says that if the lord of the Navamsa is strong, only the effects described for planetary aspects on signs and Navamsas will come to pass.

passages.text: (a). The same remark applies to the rising sign and to the Sun.
passages.summary: The translator's note says the rule about Vargottama, own and other Navamsas also applies to the rising sign and to the Sun.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person, the Sun occupy the ascendant, the person will be fond of fight, slow at work,
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun in the ascendant will be fond of fighting and slow at work.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [If at the time of birth of a person, the Sun occupy the ascendant, the person will be] without sight
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun in the ascendant will be without sight.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [If at the time of birth of a person, the Sun occupy the ascendant, the person will be] and without mercy;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born with the Sun in the ascendant will be without mercy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: but if Aries be the rising sign and the Sun occupy it the person will be rich
passages.summary: The text says that if Aries is rising with the Sun in it, the person will be rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [but if Aries be the rising sign and the Sun occupy it the person will be] and afflicted with diseases of the eye;
passages.summary: The text says that if Aries is rising with the Sun in it, the person will suffer from eye diseases.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if Leo be the rising sign and the Sun occupy it, he will be blind at night;
passages.summary: The text says that if Leo is rising with the Sun in it, the person will be blind at night.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if Libra be the rising sign and the sun occupy it, the person will be blind
passages.summary: The text says that if Libra is rising with the Sun in it, the person will be blind.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [if Libra be the rising sign and the sun occupy it, the person will be] and poor;
passages.summary: The text says that if Libra is rising with the Sun in it, the person will be poor.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if Cancer be the rising sign and the Sun occupy it, he will have a mote in his eye.
passages.summary: The text says that if Cancer is rising with the Sun in it, the person will have a mote in the eye.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If the Sun occupy the 2nd house from the ascendant, the person will be greatly rich, will have his wealth carried away by the king
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 2nd house the person will be very rich but will have wealth taken away by the king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [If the Sun occupy the 2nd house from the ascendant, the person] and will suffer from diseases in the face.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 2nd house the person will suffer from diseases of the face.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth, the Sun occupy the 3rd house from the ascendant, the person will be intelligent and powerful;
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 3rd house the person will be intelligent and powerful.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 4th house, the person will be afflicted with grief and mental sufferings;
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 4th house the person will suffer grief and mental suffering.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 5th house, he will have no sons and will be poor
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 5th house the person will have no sons and will be poor.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: and if he occupy the 6th house, the person will be powerful and be subjugated by his enemy (a).
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 6th house the person will be powerful yet subdued by an enemy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: (a). According to another reading, if the Sun occupy the 6th house from the ascendant the person's enemies, will meet with ruin. According to Satyachariar such a person will be free from enemies, diseases and grief; but the text has the support of Yavanachariar and Suchidhwaja.
passages.summary: The translator's note says another reading has the enemies of a person with the Sun in the 6th house meet with ruin, and Satyachariar says such a person will be free from enemies, disease and grief; the translator adds that the main text is supported by Yavanachariar and Suchidhwaja.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person the Sun occupy the 7th house from the ascendant, the person will suffer disgrace at the hands of women;
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 7th house the person will suffer disgrace at the hands of women.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 8th house, the person will have very few sons
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 8th house the person will have very few sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [if he occupy the 8th house, the person] and will become blind;
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 8th house the person will become blind.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 9th house, the person will have sons wealth and comfort (a);
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 9th house the person will have sons, wealth and comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 10th house, the person will live in comfort and will be powerful;
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 10th house the person will live in comfort and be powerful.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 11th house the person will be very rich
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 11th house the person will be very rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: and if he occupy the 12th house he will become an apostate.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Sun in the 12th house the person will abandon his religion.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: (a). According to another reading a person born with the Sun in the 9th house will have neither sons nor wealth. Accordingly Satyachariar says that such a person will do wicked deeds,
passages.summary: The translator's note says another reading gives a person with the Sun in the 9th house neither sons nor wealth, and Satyachariar says such a person will do wicked deeds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [Accordingly Satyachariar says that such a person] will be afflicted with diseases
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, as quoted in the translator's note, a person with the Sun in the 9th house will suffer from diseases.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [Accordingly Satyachariar says that such a person] and will attain an humble position in life.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, as quoted in the translator's note, a person with the Sun in the 9th house will reach only a humble position in life.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person the Moon occupy the ascendant such person will become dumb or mad or an idiot or blind or deaf;
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the ascendant the person will become mute, mentally ill, blind or deaf.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [If at the time of birth of a person the Moon occupy the ascendant] he will do mean deeds or will become a slave;
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the ascendant the person will do mean deeds or become a slave.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if the rising sign occupied by the Moon be Cancer, Aries or Taurus the person will be rich, will have many sons and will be wealthy respectively.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the rising sign, Cancer rising makes the person rich, Aries rising gives many sons, and Taurus rising makes the person wealthy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If the Moon occupy the 2nd house from the ascendant, the person will be a man of a large family.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 2nd house the person will have a large family.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If she occupy the third house, he will delight in torturing animals.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 3rd house the person will delight in torturing animals.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If she occupy the 4th or the 5th house, he will be in the full enjoyment of what the houses signify (a).
passages.notes: (a). That is, if the Moon occupy the 4th house from the ascendant, the person will be happy, will have kinsmen and houses, and will be learned; and if she occupy the 5th house, the person will possess intelligence, sons and the like.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 4th or 5th house the person will fully enjoy what those houses signify; the note explains this as happiness, kinsmen, houses and learning for the 4th, and intelligence and sons for the 5th.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If she occupy the 6th house, the person from will be of soft body, will have a dull appetite
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 6th house the person will have a soft body and a dull appetite.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [If she occupy the 6th house, the person from] will be sparing in sexual union, will be cruel and will be slow at work.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 6th house the person will be sparing in sexual union, cruel and slow at work.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth the Moon occupy the 7th house from the ascendant, the person will be jealous of the prosperity of other men and will be lustful.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 7th house the person will envy others' prosperity and be full of desire.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If she occupy the 8th house, the person will be fickleminded
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 8th house the person will be fickle-minded.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [If she occupy the 8th house, the person] and will be afflicted with diseases.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 8th house the person will suffer from diseases.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If she occupy the 9th house the person will be liked by all and will have sons, kinsmen and wealth.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 9th house the person will be liked by all and have sons, kinsmen and wealth.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If she occupy the 10th house, he will be successful in all places, will be virtuous, wealthy, intelligent and valorous.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 10th house the person will succeed everywhere and be virtuous, wealthy, intelligent and brave.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If she occupy the 11th house, the person will be famous and will gain wealth and the like
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 11th house the person will be famous and gain wealth.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: and if she occupy the 12th house from the ascendant, the person will be wicked
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 12th house the person will be wicked.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [and if she occupy the 12th house from the ascendant, the person will be] and of defective limbs.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 12th house the person will have defective limbs.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person Mars occupy the ascendant, such person will possess a wounded body;
passages.summary: The text says that with Mars in the ascendant the person will have a wounded body.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 2nd house, the person will eat low meals;
passages.summary: The text says that with Mars in the 2nd house the person will eat poor meals.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 9th house, the person will be a sinner
passages.summary: The text says that with Mars in the 9th house the person will be a sinner.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: and if he occupy the remaining houses (a) he will produce the same effects as the Sun in those places.
passages.notes: (a). That is the 3rd 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, 8th, 10th, 11th, and 12th houses.
passages.summary: The text says that Mars in any of the remaining houses (3rd to 8th and 10th to 12th) gives the same effects as the Sun in those houses.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: Again, if at the time of birth of a person Mercury occupy the ascendant such person will be learned.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in the ascendant the person will be learned.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If he occupy the 2nd house, the person will be wealthy.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in the 2nd house the person will be wealthy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If he occupy the 3rd house the person will be wicked.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in the 3rd house the person will be wicked.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If he occupy the 4th house, the person will be learned.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in the 4th house the person will be learned.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If he occupy the 5th house, he will be a minister under a king;
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in the 5th house the person will be a minister under a king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if he occupy the 6th house, he will have no enemies.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in the 6th house the person will have no enemies.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If he occupy the 7th house, he will possess a knowledge of law.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in the 7th house the person will know the law.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If he occupy the 8th house, the person will be renowned for his virtues.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in the 8th house the person will be renowned for his virtues.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If he occupy the 9th, 10th, 11th and 12th houses he will produce the same effects as the Sun in those places.
passages.summary: The text says that Mercury in the 9th, 10th, 11th or 12th house gives the same effects as the Sun in those houses.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person Jupiter occupy the 12 signs from the ascendant, such person will respectively be learned, of good speech, a niggard, will live in comfort, will be intelligent, will have no enemies, will possess qualities superior to those of his father, will do deeds unsuited to his rank in life, will be a devotee, will be possessed of wealth, will be full of gain and will do fearful deeds.
passages.summary: The text gives results for Jupiter in each of the twelve houses in turn: learned, well-spoken, miserly, comfortable, intelligent, without enemies, better in qualities than his father, doing deeds unsuited to his rank, devout, wealthy, full of gain, and doing fearful deeds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person Venus occupy the ascendant, such person will be skilled in acts of love and will live in great comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that with Venus in the ascendant the person will be skilled in love and live in great comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if Venus occupy the 7th house, the person will be fond of quarrels and of sexual union;
passages.summary: The text says that with Venus in the 7th house the person will be fond of quarrels and of sexual union.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: if Venus occupy the 5th house the person will live in comfort
passages.summary: The text says that with Venus in the 5th house the person will live in comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: and if he occupy the remaining houses (a) the effects will be the same as those of Jupiter in those places;
passages.notes: (a). That is the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 6th, 8th, 9th, 10th, 11th and 12th houses.
passages.summary: The text says that Venus in any of the remaining houses gives the same effects as Jupiter in those houses.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: but if Venus occupy sign Pisces at the time of birth the person will become rich.
passages.summary: The text says that with Venus in Pisces the person will become rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person Saturn occupy the ascendant, such person will be poor,
passages.summary: The text says that with Saturn in the ascendant the person will be poor.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [If at the time of birth of a person Saturn occupy the ascendant, such person] will be afflicted with diseases and sexual passion, will be dirty will suffer much from diseases while young and will be of indistinct speech.
passages.summary: The text says that with Saturn in the ascendant the person will suffer from diseases and sexual passion, be unclean, be much diseased when young and have indistinct speech.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: But if the ascendant, occupied by Saturn, be Libra, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, the person will be as happy as a king, will rule over a village or a town,
passages.summary: The text says that if Saturn is in the ascendant and the rising sign is Libra, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, the person will be as happy as a king and rule over a village or town.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [But if the ascendant, occupied by Saturn, be Libra, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, the person] will be learned
passages.summary: The text says that if Saturn is in the ascendant and the rising sign is Libra, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, the person will be learned.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: [But if the ascendant, occupied by Saturn, be Libra, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, the person] and will possess fine limbs.
passages.summary: The text says that if Saturn is in the ascendant and the rising sign is Libra, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius or Pisces, the person will have fine limbs.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: But if Saturn occupy any of the other houses (from the 2nd to the 12th) the effects will be the same as those of the Sun in the same places.
passages.summary: The text says that Saturn in any house from the 2nd to the 12th gives the same effects as the Sun in those houses.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: In determining the effects of the planets in the several houses from the ascendant the nature of such houses shall be taken into account, that is, whether the houses occupied by the several planets are their friendly signs or inimical or neutral signs or their own houses or their exaltation signs and the like (a).
passages.notes: (a). That is if the houses occupied by the planets be their exaltation signs, their friendly signs or their own houses the effects described will fully come to pass; if such houses be their inimical signs the effects will fail and if the houses be neutral signs, neither more nor less of the effects described will come to pass. All this is according to Garga.
passages.summary: The text says that when judging planets in the houses, one must consider whether each planet stands in a friendly, hostile, neutral, own or exaltation sign; the note, following Garga, says the effects come fully in exaltation, friendly or own signs, fail in hostile signs, and come as described in neutral signs.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: Again, according to Satyachariar, benefic planets promote the bhavas while malefic ones reduce them; but in the cases of the 6th, 8th and 12th houses the reverse is the case (b).
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, as the text reports, benefic planets strengthen the houses they occupy and malefic ones weaken them, except in the 6th, 8th and 12th houses, where the reverse holds.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: (b). According to Satyachariar, if a benefic planet occupy the 6th house the enemies will meet with ruin and if a malefic planet occupy it, the enemies will increase.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, as quoted in the translator's note, a benefic in the 6th house ruins the person's enemies while a malefic there increases them.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: Again, if a benefic planet occupy the 8th house, a person will be freed from dangers to life and if a malefic planet occupy it, danger to life will increase.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, as quoted in the translator's note, a benefic in the 8th house frees the person from dangers to life while a malefic there increases such danger.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: Lastly if a benefic planet occupy the 12th house there will be no loss to the person and if a malefic planet occupy it there will be an increase of loss.
passages.summary: According to Satyachariar, as quoted in the translator's note, a benefic in the 12th house means no loss while a malefic there increases loss.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If the planets to which good effects have been assigned occupy their exaltation signs such effects will fully come to pass. If they occupy their Moolatrikona signs only three-fourths of such effects will come to pass; if they occupy their own houses one-half of such effects will come to pass; if they occupy their friendly signs one-quarter of such effects will come to pass; if they occupy their inimical signs less than one-quarter of such effects will come to pass and if the planets occupy their depression signs or if they happen to be Astangata planets the good effects described will wholly fail.
passages.summary: The text says good effects come in full when the planet is exalted, three-quarters in its Moolatrikona sign, half in its own sign, a quarter in a friendly sign, less than a quarter in a hostile sign, and not at all when debilitated or combust.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Bhavas
passages.text: If the effects be bad, then if the planets occupy their depression signs or if they be Astangata planets, the evil effects will fully come to pass. If they occupy their inimical signs, then three-fourths, if they occupy their friendly signs, then one-half, if they occupy their own signs then one-quarter, if they occupy their MoolaTrikona signs, then less than a quarter of the evil effects will come to pass. But if they occupy their exaltation signs, the evil effects will fail.
passages.summary: The translator's note says bad effects come in full when the planet is debilitated or combust, three-quarters in a hostile sign, half in a friendly sign, a quarter in its own sign, less than a quarter in its Moolatrikona sign, and not at all when exalted.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: If a single planet occupy its own house at the time of birth of a person such person will possess the average dignity of the members of his family ;
passages.summary: The text says that if one planet is in its own sign at birth, the person will have the average standing of the members of his family.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: if two planets occupy their own houses the person will be an important member of his family;
passages.summary: The text says that if two planets are in their own signs, the person will be an important member of his family.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: if three planets occupy their own houses, the person will be respected by his kinsmen ;
passages.summary: The text says that if three planets are in their own signs, the person will be respected by his relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: if four planets occupy their own houses, the person will be rich ;
passages.summary: The text says that if four planets are in their own signs, the person will be rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [planets occupy their own houses] if five planets do so he will live in comfort;
passages.summary: The text says that if five planets are in their own signs, the person will live in comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [planets occupy their own houses] if six, he will live in luxurious ease and as happy as a king
passages.summary: The text says that if six planets are in their own signs, the person will live in luxurious ease, as happy as a king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: and if seven planets occupy their own houses the person will become a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if all seven planets are in their own signs, the person will become a king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: Again if one of the planets occupy a friendly sign, the person will lead a dependent life ;
passages.summary: The text says that if one planet is in a friendly sign, the person will lead a dependent life.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the planets occupy a friendly sign] if two planets do so he will be protected by his friends ;
passages.summary: The text says that if two planets are in friendly signs, the person will be protected by his friends.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the planets occupy a friendly sign] if three, [he will be protected] by his kinsmen ;
passages.summary: The text says that if three planets are in friendly signs, the person will be protected by his relatives.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the planets occupy a friendly sign] if four, [he will be protected] by his brothers and cousins ;
passages.summary: The text says that if four planets are in friendly signs, the person will be protected by his brothers and cousins.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the planets occupy a friendly sign] if five, the person will be a master over many people;
passages.summary: The text says that if five planets are in friendly signs, the person will be a master over many people.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the planets occupy a friendly sign] if six, he will become a commander of an army
passages.summary: The text says that if six planets are in friendly signs, the person will become the commander of an army.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the planets occupy a friendly sign] and if seven, he will become a king.
passages.summary: The text says that if all seven planets are in friendly signs, the person will become a king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person, a single planet occupy its exaltation sign and be aspected by a friendly planet such person will become a king;
passages.summary: The text says that if one planet is in its sign of exaltation and is aspected by a friendly planet, the person will become a king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: if at the time of birth one of the planets occupy its exaltation sign and be accompanied by a friendly planet, the person will become very rich and will be universally respected ;
passages.summary: The text says that if one planet is in its sign of exaltation together with a friendly planet, the person will become very rich and universally respected.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: if at the time of birth one of the planets occupy either an inimical or a depression sign, the person will become poor ;
passages.summary: The text says that if one planet is in an enemy's sign or its sign of debilitation, the person will become poor.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: if two planets occupy their inimical or depression signs, the person will become afflicted with grief.
passages.summary: The text says that if two planets are in enemy signs or signs of debilitation, the person will be afflicted with grief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: If three planets occupy their inimical or depression signs, the person will become a fool.
passages.summary: The text says that if three planets are in enemy signs or signs of debilitation, the person will become a fool.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [occupy their inimical or depression signs] If four planets do so, the person will become afflicted with diseases.
passages.summary: The text says that if four planets are in enemy signs or signs of debilitation, the person will be afflicted with diseases.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [occupy their inimical or depression signs] If five planets do so the person will suffer imprisonment;
passages.summary: The text says that if five planets are in enemy signs or signs of debilitation, the person will suffer imprisonment.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [occupy their inimical or depression signs] if six planets the person will be a victim to much grief
passages.summary: The text says that if six planets are in enemy signs or signs of debilitation, the person will suffer much grief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [occupy their inimical or depression signs] and if seven planets do so, he will subject to torture persons who ought not to be tortured.
passages.summary: The text says that if all seven planets are in enemy signs or signs of debilitation, the person will torture people who ought not to be tortured.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: Mercury and the Sun cannot at the same time occupy their depression signs— viz. Pisces and Libra respectively. Seven planets cannot therefore occupy their depression signs at the same time. In this as in certain other cases already stated, the author has simply quoted the views of former writers.
passages.summary: The translator's note says Mercury and the Sun can never be in their signs of debilitation (Pisces and Libra) at the same time, so all seven planets cannot be debilitated together; the author is simply quoting earlier writers here.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: According to Satyachariar a person born when Aquarius is the rising sign will not be happy ;
passages.summary: According to Satyacharya, as the text reports, a person born with Aquarius rising will not be happy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: but according to Yavanas, a person born when Aquarius is the rising Dwadasamsa will not be happy. This latter view is objected to by Vishnugupta on the ground that each sign of the Zodiac contains the Dwadasamsa of Aquarius and that beneficial effects have been ascribed to several signs.
passages.summary: According to the Yavanas, a person born when the rising twelfth-part (Dwadasamsa) is that of Aquarius will not be happy. The text adds that Vishnugupta objects to this, since every sign contains an Aquarius Dwadasamsa and good effects are ascribed to several signs.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person, born when malefic planets occupy the solar horas of odd signs will be of widespread fame, will do important deeds, will be powerful, wealthy and of bright appearance.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when malefic planets are in the Sun's half (hora) of odd signs will be widely famous, will do important deeds, and will be powerful, wealthy and bright in appearance.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when benefic planets occupy the lunar horas of even signs will be of gentle manners and of bright appearance; will live in comfort, will be liked by all ; will be intelligent and will be of sweet speech.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when benefic planets are in the Moon's half (hora) of even signs will be gentle and bright in appearance, will live in comfort, will be liked by all, and will be intelligent and sweet-spoken.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: If the horas occupied by the malefic and benefic planets be the same as stated above while the signs are different, (a) the person will be all that has been stated above for the two yogas in a moderate degree ;
passages.notes: (a). That is if the malefic planets occupy the solar horas in even signs or the benefic planets occupy the lunar horas in odd signs.
passages.summary: The text says that if the malefics or benefics are in the same horas as in the previous verse but in signs of the other kind, the person will have the results of those two yogas in a moderate degree.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: but if both the horas and signs be different (b) the effects will fail.
passages.notes: (b) That is if the malefic planets occupy the lunar horas of the even signs or the benefic planets occupy the solar horas of odd signs.
passages.summary: The text says that if both the horas and the signs differ from those of the previous verse, the effects will not come about.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: N. B. Both the author and commentator have failed to notice the case of a person born when the malefic planets occupy the lunar horas of odd signs or the benefic planets occupy the solar horas of even signs. Evidently a person born under these yogas will be all that has been stated in the 4th stanza in a moderate degree.
passages.summary: The translator's note says the author and commentator overlooked the case of malefics in the Moon's horas of odd signs or benefics in the Sun's horas of even signs, and that such a person will have the results of the 4th stanza in a moderate degree.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when the Moon occupies either her own Drekkana or a friendly (a) Drekkana will be of very fine beauty and of well-known virtues ;
passages.notes: (a). Friendly at the time of birth. Vide chapter II stanza 13.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when the Moon is in her own or a friendly decanate (Drekkana) will be very beautiful and of well-known virtues.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: but if the Moon occupy other Drekkanas the person will be what has been stated above agreeably to the character of the lord of such Drekkana.(b)
passages.notes: (b). That is if such lord be neutral (at the time of birth) to the Moon, the person will be what has been stated in a moderate degree ; but if he be inimical to the Moon, the effects will fail.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in other decanates, the person will have those results according to the nature of the decanate's lord.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: If at the time of birth the Moon occupy a Sarpa (serpent) Drekkana (c) the person will be wicked ;
passages.notes: (c). Sarpa Vyala Drekkanas : These are the 2nd Drekkana of Cancer, the 1st of Vrischika and the 3rd of Pisces
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Sarpa (serpent) decanate, the person will be wicked.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: if she occupy an Ayudha (weapon) Drekkana (d) the person will do deeds of torture ;
passages.notes: (d). Ayudha Drekkanas : These are the 1st and 3rd Drekkanas of Aries, the 2nd of Gemini, the 1st of Leo, the 2nd of Libra and the 1st of Aquarius
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in an Ayudha (weapon) decanate, the person will do deeds of torture.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: if she occupy a Chatushpad (quadruped) Drekkana (e) the person will cohabit with his preceptor's wife,
passages.notes: (e). Chatushpad Drekkanas : These are the 2nd Drekkana of Aries, the 2nd and 3rd of Taurus, the 1st of Cancer, the 3rd of Libra, the 3rd of Scorpio and the 1st of Sagittarius
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Chatushpad (quadruped) decanate, the person will have relations with his teacher's wife.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: and if she occupy a Pakshi (bird) Drekkana (f) the person will be of wandering habits.
passages.notes: (f). Pakshi Drekkanas : These are 2nd Drekkana of Aries, the 2nd of Gemini, the 1st of Leo and the 2nd of Libra.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in a Pakshi (bird) decanate, the person will be of wandering habits.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: If the Drekkanas occupied by the Moon be of more than one character, the person will be all that has been stated for each character.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if the Moon's decanate belongs to more than one of these classes, the person will have the results stated for each class.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when the rising Navamsa (a) is that of Aries will be a thief ;
passages.notes: (a). These Navamsas of Aries, Taurus, Gemini &c., are Navamsas other than those of the respective signs Aries, Taurus, Gemini &c.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when the rising ninth-part (Navamsa) is that of Aries will be a thief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Taurus, he will enjoy away his earnings ;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Taurus, the person will spend away his earnings on enjoyment.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Gemini, the person will be learned ;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Gemini, the person will be learned.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Cancer he will be wealthy ;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Cancer, the person will be wealthy.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Leo, he will be a king ;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Leo, the person will be a king.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Virgo, he will be hermaphrodite ;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Virgo, the person will be a hermaphrodite.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Libra, he will be bold in fight ;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Libra, the person will be bold in fighting.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Scorpio, he will earn his livelihood by carrying loads;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Scorpio, the person will earn his living by carrying loads.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Sagitari he will become a slave ;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Sagittarius, the person will become a slave.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Capricorn he will be a sinner ;
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Capricorn, the person will be a sinner.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] when it is that of Aquarius, he will be wicked
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Aquarius, the person will be wicked.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the rising Navamsa] and when it is that of Pisces he will be fearless.
passages.summary: The text says that when the rising Navamsa is that of Pisces, the person will be fearless.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: But if the rising Navamsa be at the same time a Vargottama Navamsa (b) the person born will be the chief of the respective classes of persons mentioned (c).
passages.notes:
(b). That is Navamsas excluded in note (a).
(c). For instance, the person will be a chief of thieves &c.
passages.summary: The text says that if the rising Navamsa is also Vargottama (the same sign as the rising sign), the person will be the chief of the class of people named for that Navamsa; the note gives a chief of thieves as an example.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: The rising Dwadasamsas produce the same effects as the rising signs.
passages.summary: The text says that the rising twelfth-parts (Dwadasamsas) produce the same effects as the corresponding rising signs.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when Mars occupies his own Trimsamsa will be a married man,
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when Mars is in his own thirtieth-part (Trimsamsa) will be a married man.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [A person born when Mars occupies his own Trimsamsa] will be powerful, will wear ornaments, will be generous, will be of bright appearance and will thoughtlessly engage in work.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mars in his own Trimsamsa the person will be powerful, wear ornaments, be generous and bright in appearance, and will take up work without thinking.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when Saturn occupies his own Trimsamsa will be afflicted with diseases ;
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when Saturn is in his own Trimsamsa will be afflicted with diseases.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [A person born when Saturn occupies his own Trimsamsa] his wife will die before him,
passages.summary: The text says that with Saturn in his own Trimsamsa the person's wife will die before him.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [A person born when Saturn occupies his own Trimsamsa] he will be wicked, will covet the wives of other men, will be afflicted with grief,
passages.summary: The text says that with Saturn in his own Trimsamsa the person will be wicked, will desire other men's wives, and will be afflicted with grief.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [A person born when Saturn occupies his own Trimsamsa] will have a house, clothes, attendants and the like
passages.summary: The text says that with Saturn in his own Trimsamsa the person will have a house, clothes, attendants and the like.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [A person born when Saturn occupies his own Trimsamsa] and will be dirty.
passages.summary: The text says that with Saturn in his own Trimsamsa the person will be dirty.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when Jupiter occupies his own Trimsamsa will be rich, famous, happy, intelligent, of bright appearance, universally respected, free from diseases, of active habits and will live in luxury.
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when Jupiter is in his own Trimsamsa will be rich, famous, happy, intelligent, bright in appearance, universally respected, free from disease, active, and will live in luxury.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when Mercury occupies his own Trimsamsa will be intelligent and learned in the fine arts; will be a fop, a literary author, of distinct speech, will be skilled in carpentry and the like,
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when Mercury is in his own Trimsamsa will be intelligent and learned in the fine arts, a dandy, a literary author, clear in speech, and skilled in carpentry and similar crafts.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [A person born when Mercury occupies his own Trimsamsa] will follow the rules of life laid down by sages, will commence bold projects and will be much respected.
passages.summary: The text says that with Mercury in his own Trimsamsa the person will follow the rules of life laid down by sages, will start bold projects, and will be much respected.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when Venus occupies his own Trimsamsa will have many sons,
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when Venus is in its own Trimsamsa will have many sons.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [A person born when Venus occupies his own Trimsamsa] will live in comfort, will be free from diseases, will love mankind,
passages.summary: The text says that with Venus in its own Trimsamsa the person will live in comfort, be free from disease, and love mankind.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [A person born when Venus occupies his own Trimsamsa] will be rich, beautiful, wicked, of fair body and will enjoy many women.
passages.summary: The text says that with Venus in its own Trimsamsa the person will be rich, beautiful, wicked, fair-bodied, and will enjoy many women.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when the Trimsamsa of Mars is occupied by the Sun, will be bold in fight
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when the Sun is in a Trimsamsa of Mars will be bold in fighting.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the Trimsamsa of Mars] and when it is occupied by the Moon he will be slow at work.
passages.summary: The text says that when the Moon is in a Trimsamsa of Mars, the person will be slow at work.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when the Trimsamsa of Saturn is occupied by the Sun will be wicked
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when the Sun is in a Trimsamsa of Saturn will be wicked.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the Trimsamsa of Saturn] and when it is occupied by the Moon, he will indulge in acts of torture.
passages.summary: The text says that when the Moon is in a Trimsamsa of Saturn, the person will commit acts of torture.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when the Trimsamsa of Jupiter is occupied by the Sun will be of good disposition
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when the Sun is in a Trimsamsa of Jupiter will be of good disposition.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the Trimsamsa of Jupiter] and when it is occupied by the Moon, the person will become rich
passages.summary: The text says that when the Moon is in a Trimsamsa of Jupiter, the person will become rich.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when the Trimsamsa of Mercury is occupied by the Sun will live in comfort
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when the Sun is in a Trimsamsa of Mercury will live in comfort.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the Trimsamsa of Mercury] and when it is occupied by the Moon the person will be learned.
passages.summary: The text says that when the Moon is in a Trimsamsa of Mercury, the person will be learned.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: A person born when the Trimsamsa of Venus is occupied by the Sun, will possess a fine body
passages.summary: The text says that a person born when the Sun is in a Trimsamsa of Venus will have a fine body.

passages.chapterTitle: On the Planets in the Several Vargas
passages.text: [the Trimsamsa of Venus] and when it is occupied by the Moon he will be liked by the people.
passages.summary: The text says that when the Moon is in a Trimsamsa of Venus, the person will be liked by the people.

passages.text: Planets occupying their own signs or their exaltation or Mulatrikona signs are said to be Karaka planets to one another, if, at the same time they occupy the Kendras from the ascendant. In the above case a planet occupying the 10th house from another planet is said to be the special Karaka of that planet.
passages.notes: In this and in the next two stanzas the term "Karaka (helping) planets" is defined.
passages.summary: The text defines Karaka (helping) planets: planets in their own, exaltation or Mulatrikona signs that also occupy the angular houses from the ascendant are Karakas to one another. Among them, a planet in the 10th house from another is called that planet's special Karaka. It gives no results.

passages.text: Accordingly, if the rising sign be Cancer and the Moon occupy it and if Mars, Saturn, the Sun and Jupiter occupy their exaltation signs, these four planets are known as Karaka planets to one another (a).
passages.notes: (a). In other words Jupiter occupies sign Cancer which is at the same time the rising sign, Saturn occupies the 4th house Libra, Mars the 7th house Capricorn and the Sun the 10th house Aries. The commentator infers from this stanza that planets occupying their Swakshetra, Ucha and Mulatrikona signs are also mutually Karaka planets, if they occupy Kendra signs from one another though not the Kendra signs from the ascendant.
passages.summary: The text gives an example of Karaka planets: with Cancer rising and the Moon in it, and Mars, Saturn, the Sun and Jupiter in their exaltation signs, these four planets are Karakas to one another. It gives no results.

passages.text: Again, to a planet occupying the rising sign all planets (b) occupying the 10th or the 4th house are Karaka planets (c).
passages.notes:
(b). All the planets whether they occupy their own signs, their exaltation signs or their Mulatrikona signs or not, according to the commentator.
(c). That is the reverse does not hold. In other words the planet occupying the ascendant is not a Karaka planet of those occupying the 4th or the 10th house.
passages.summary: The text says that for a planet in the rising sign, all planets in the 10th or 4th house are its Karaka planets. It gives no results.

passages.text: A planet occupying its Mulatrikona and exaltation sign (a) is also said to be a Karaka planet to one that occupies the 10th house (b) from such sign, and to the latter his Atimitra planet is also said to be a Karaka planet.
passages.notes:
(a). But not occupying the Kendra houses from the ascendant.
(b). This latter planet must be in his Swakshetra, Mulatrikona or exaltation house.
passages.summary: The text says a planet in its Mulatrikona and exaltation sign is a Karaka planet to a planet in the 10th house from that sign, and that the latter planet's great friend is also its Karaka. It gives no results.

passages.text: The effects of the Karaka planets are described in Varaha Mihira's work on Yoga Yatra in which it is stated that when a prince loses his kingdom, he recovers it in the Anturdasa period of a Karaka planet; again it is said that a man enjoys comfort, wealth and success when the Moon passes through the house of a Karaka planet, or through the 2nd house from that occupied by the Sun. Also, that the journey may be a successful one it shall be commenced when the Moon occupies either of the two places mentioned above — otherwise the traveller will receive blows on his way.
passages.summary: The translator's note cites Varaha Mihira's Yoga Yatra: a prince who loses his kingdom regains it in the sub-period of a Karaka planet, and a man enjoys comfort, wealth and success when the Moon passes through a Karaka planet's house or the 2nd house from the Sun. Journeys should begin when the Moon is in one of those places, or else the traveller will receive blows on the way.

passages.text: A person born when the rising Navamsa is a Vargottama one or when the Moon occupies a Vargottama position will be happy and prosperous.
passages.summary: The text says a person born when the rising Navamsa is Vargottama, or when the Moon is in a Vargottama position, will be happy and prosperous.

passages.text: The same remark applies to a person at the time of whose birth the 2nd house from the Sun may be occupied by benefic planets
passages.summary: The text says a person will likewise be happy and prosperous if benefic planets occupy the 2nd house from the Sun at birth.

passages.text: [The same remark applies to a person at the time of whose birth] the Kendra houses may happen to be occupied by planets at all (a).
passages.notes: (a). If one of the Kendras be occupied the person will be happy; if two or more be occupied he will be happier still and if the planets be benefic the person will be exceedingly happy and prosperous.
passages.summary: The text says a person will likewise be happy and prosperous if the angular houses are occupied by any planets at birth.

passages.text: Also, a person at the time of whose birth there are Karaka planets occupying the signs of the Zodiac will be happy and prosperous.
passages.summary: The text says a person born when there are Karaka planets in the chart will be happy and prosperous.

passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person Jupiter, the lord of the sign occupied by the Moon, or the lord of the ascendant occupy a Kendra house, such person will be happy when in his manhood.
passages.summary: The text says that if Jupiter, the lord of the Moon's sign, or the lord of the ascendant occupies an angular house at birth, the person will be happy in his adult years.

passages.text: Again, if at the time of commencement of a dasa period the lord of such period happen to occupy a Prishtodaya sign, he will produce his effects at the end of the period. If such lord occupy a Sirodaya sign he will produce his effects at the commencement of the period and if he occupy a Sira-Prishtodaya sign, the effects will be felt in the middle of the period.
passages.notes: The Dasa period is to be divided into three equal parts and the Sirodaya, Prishtodaya and Siraprishtodaya signs are defined in stanza 10 of Chapter I.
passages.summary: The text says the lord of a planetary period gives its effects at the end of the period if it occupies a hind-rising sign when the period begins, at the start if in a head-rising sign, and in the middle if in a sign rising both ways. It states timing only, not particular results.

passages.text: The Sun and Mars produce their effects immediately after entering a sign; Jupiter and Venus when passing through the middle of a sign; Saturn and the Moon before quitting a sign and Mercury throughout his course.
passages.notes: The sign must be supposed to be divided into three equal parts of 10 degrees each.
passages.summary: The text says the Sun and Mars give their effects just after entering a sign, Jupiter and Venus in the middle of a sign, Saturn and the Moon just before leaving a sign, and Mercury throughout. It states timing only, not particular results.

passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person the 5th and 7th houses from the ascendant or from the Moon be either occupied or aspected by benefic planets or by their lords, such person will have respectively sons (a) and a wife — otherwise, (b) he will not have either the one or the other.
passages.notes: (a.) One of 12 sorts of sons (1) Oorasa, (2) Kshetraja, (3) Datta, (4) Krittrima (5) Gudhotpanna, (6) Apavidha, (7) Kaneena, (8) Sahodha, (9) Kreeta, (10) Pounarbhava, (11) Swayamdatta and (12) Adharmaprabhava. (b.) That is if the 5th and 7th houses from the ascendant or the Moon be not occupied or aspected by benefic planets or by the lords of the houses.
passages.summary: The text says that if benefic planets or the houses' own lords occupy or aspect the 5th and 7th houses from the ascendant or the Moon, the person will have sons and a wife respectively; otherwise he will have neither.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If Virgo be the rising sign and if the Sun occupy it, the person will lose his wife provided Saturn occupies sign Pisces at the same time
passages.summary: The text says that with Virgo rising and the Sun in it, the person will lose his wife if Saturn is in Pisces.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: [If Virgo be the rising sign and if the Sun occupy it, the person] will lose his sons if Mars occupy sign Capricorn at the same time.
passages.summary: The text says that with Virgo rising and the Sun in it, the person will lose his sons if Mars is in Capricorn.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If the Moon and Saturn occupy the 7th house a person's wife will quit him and marry another.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if the Moon and Saturn are in the 7th house, the person's wife will leave him and marry another.

passages.text: If the 7th house be aspected by the Moon and Saturn the number of wives of a person will be the number represented by the Navamsa occupied by the lord of the 7th house counting from the Navamsa of Aries.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if the Moon and Saturn aspect the 7th house, the number of wives equals the count of the Navamsa held by the 7th lord, reckoned from the Navamsa of Aries.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If Jupiter or the Moon and Venus occupy the 7th house and the Navamsa of the Sun or Mars, the person will have a single wife;
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if Jupiter, or the Moon and Venus, are in the 7th house and in a Navamsa of the Sun or Mars, the person will have one wife.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: but if the 7th house be aspected by the Moon and Venus, the person will have several wives.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if the Moon and Venus aspect the 7th house, the person will have several wives.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, malefic planets occupy the 4th and 8th houses from Venus or if malefic planets be on both sides of Venus or if Venus be not accompanied or aspected by benefic planets the person's wife will die by fire, by fall or by ropes respectively.
passages.notes: Provided, in the first Yoga, Venus at the same time occupies an Agni (fiery) Drekkana, in the second a Nipata (falling) Drekkana and in the third a Pasa (rope) Drekkana. (Vide Chapter 27 on the Drekkanas.)
passages.summary: The text says that malefics in the 4th and 8th from Venus, malefics on both sides of Venus, or Venus unsupported by benefics bring the wife's death by fire, a fall, or ropes respectively.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, one of the two houses, the 12th and the 6th, from the ascendant be occupied by the Sun and the other by the Moon, the person and his wife will each have a single eye.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Sun and Moon occupy the 12th and 6th houses between them, the person and his wife will each have only one eye.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Again, if Venus and the Sun (a) occupy one of the three houses the 7th, the 9th and the 5th from the ascendant, the person [?] will be of defective limbs.
passages.summary: The text says that if Venus and the Sun occupy the 7th, 9th or 5th house, the person (a word here is illegible) will have defective limbs.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: (a.) Venus or the Moon according to some. This is opposed to Garga whom the commentator quotes.
passages.summary: The translator's note says some authorities read Venus or the Moon here, a reading opposed to Garga, whom the commentator quotes.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, Saturn occupy the rising sign (a) and if Venus occupy the Chakra-sandhi Navamsas and the 7th house, the person's wife will be barren (b), provided the 5th house is not occupied by benefic planets.
passages.notes: (a.) It is clear that the rising sign must be Taurus or Virgo or Capricorn in which case the 7th houses will respectively be Scorpio; Pisces and Cancer and the last Navamsas of these three houses are known as Chakrasandhies or Rikshasandhies (Vide stanza 7 Ch. I.)
passages.summary: The text says that with Saturn rising and Venus in the 7th house in a Chakra-sandhi Navamsa, the wife will be barren unless benefics occupy the 5th house.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Again, if the malefic planets occupy the 12th and the 7th houses and the ascendant and the waning Moon occupy the 6th house, the person will have neither wife nor sons.
passages.summary: The text says that with malefics in the 12th, 7th and ascendant and the waning Moon in the 6th house, the person will have neither wife nor sons.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: (b.) If the person will marry again, he may get sons according to some.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that, according to some, the person may get sons if he marries again.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, Venus occupy the 7th house from the ascendant and be in the varga (division) of Saturn or Mars and be aspected by Saturn or Mars, the person will commit adultery.
passages.summary: The text says that Venus in the 7th house in a division of Saturn or Mars and aspected by either makes the person commit adultery.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Again, if when Venus occupies the varga of Saturn or Mars and is aspected by Saturn or Mars, the Moon, Saturn and Mars occupy the 7th house from the ascendant, both the man and his wife will commit adultery.
passages.summary: The text says that if Venus is so placed and the Moon, Saturn and Mars are in the 7th house, both husband and wife will commit adultery.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Again, if when Venus and the Moon occupy a sign, Saturn and Mars occupy the 7th house from the ascendant, the person will have neither wife nor sons.
passages.summary: The text says that if Venus and the Moon share a sign while Saturn and Mars are in the 7th house, the person will have neither wife nor sons.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Again, if, when male and female planets occupy a sign, Saturn and Mars occupy the 7th house from the ascendant and be aspected by benefic planets, the person's wife will be of advanced age and the man will marry late in life.
passages.summary: The text says that if male and female planets share a sign while Saturn and Mars are in the 7th house aspected by benefics, the wife will be older and the man will marry late.

passages.text: If at the time of birth of a person the Moon occupy the 10th house, Venus the 7th house and the malefic planets the 4th house, such a person will destroy his family. (a)
passages.notes: (a.) The family will become extinct with him.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 10th, Venus in the 7th and malefics in the 4th house, the person will destroy his family, which the note explains as the family line ending with him.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth, Saturn occupy a Kendra house and aspect a sign the Drekkana of whose lord may be occupied by Mercury, the person will become a painter.
passages.summary: The text says that if Saturn in a Kendra aspects a sign whose lord's Drekkana holds Mercury, the person will become a painter.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth, Venus occupy the 12th house from the ascendant and the Navamsa of Saturn, the person will be the son of a serving woman;
passages.summary: The text says that Venus in the 12th house in a Navamsa of Saturn makes the person the son of a serving woman.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: if at the time of birth the Sun and the Moon occupy the 7th house and be aspected by Saturn, the person will do deeds unsuited to his rank in life.
passages.summary: The text says that the Sun and Moon in the 7th house aspected by Saturn make the person do deeds unsuited to his rank.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, Venus and Mars occupy the 7th house from the ascendant and be aspected by malefic planets such person will be afflicted with swelling illness (a).
passages.notes: (a.) Such as elephantiasis and the like.
passages.summary: The text says that Venus and Mars in the 7th house aspected by malefics bring a swelling illness.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, the Moon occupy the Navamsa of Cancer or Scorpio and be accompanied by malefic planets the person will be afflicted with diseases of the genital organ.
passages.summary: The text says that the Moon in a Navamsa of Cancer or Scorpio with malefics brings diseases of the genital organ.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth, the Moon occupy the ascendant, Saturn and Mars occupy the [?] and 2nd houses and the Sun the 7th house, the person will be afflicted with white leprosy.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon rising, Saturn and Mars in the 2nd and another house (illegible), and the Sun in the 7th, the person will suffer white leprosy.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, the Moon occupy the 10th house from the ascendant, Mars the 7th house and Saturn the 2nd house from the Sun, such person will be of defective limbs.
passages.summary: The text says that with the Moon in the 10th, Mars in the 7th and Saturn 2nd from the Sun, the person will have defective limbs.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, the Moon occupy a place between Saturn and Mars and the Sun occupy sign Capricorn, such person will be afflicted with asthma, consumption, and the diseases of the spleen;
passages.summary: The text says that the Moon between Saturn and Mars with the Sun in Capricorn brings asthma, consumption and diseases of the spleen.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: if at the time of birth, the Sun occupy the sign or the Navamsa of the Moon, the person will be afflicted with pulmonary consumption,
passages.summary: The text says that the Sun in the Moon's sign or Navamsa brings pulmonary consumption.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: if the Sun and the Moon occupy together either Cancer or Leo, the person will be reduced to a skeleton.
passages.summary: The text says that the Sun and Moon together in Cancer or Leo will reduce the person to a skeleton.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, the Moon occupy the 5th Navamsa of Sagittari (a) or the Navamsa of Pisces, Cancer, Capricorn, or Aries (b), and be either accompanied or aspected by Saturn and Mars, such person will be afflicted with leprosy (c).
passages.notes: (a.) That is the Navamsa of Leo in sign Sagittari. (b.) These may be Navamsas of any sign.
passages.summary: The text says that the Moon in the 5th Navamsa of Sagittarius or in a Navamsa of Pisces, Cancer, Capricorn or Aries, joined or aspected by Saturn and Mars, brings leprosy.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Again, if the 5th or the 9th house from the ascendant be sign Scorpio, Cancer, Taurus, or Capricorn and be either occupied or aspected by Saturn and Mars, the person will also be afflicted with leprosy.
passages.summary: The text says that if the 5th or 9th house is Scorpio, Cancer, Taurus or Capricorn and is occupied or aspected by Saturn and Mars, the person will also have leprosy.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: (c.) According to Yavanacharya, if the Moon be aspected by benefic planets also at the same time, the person will be of disfigured body resulting from scratching.
passages.summary: According to Yavanacharya, if the Moon is also aspected by benefics, the person's body will be disfigured from scratching.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, the Sun, the Moon, Mars and Saturn occupy the 8th, 6th, 2nd and 12th houses in any way, such person will become blind by causes pertaining to the most powerful of the four planets (a).
passages.notes: (a.) If the powerful planet be the Moon, blindness will be caused by phlegmatic affections. If such planet be Mars, it will be caused by bilious affections; if it be the Sun, then by heat or wood; and if it be Saturn, it will be caused by windy affections, by stones and like.
