passages.summary: The text says that the Sun, Moon, Mars and Saturn in the 8th, 6th, 2nd and 12th houses in any order cause blindness from causes linked to the strongest of them.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, the malefic planets (a) occupy the 9th, 11th, 3rd and 5th houses and be not aspected by benefic planets, such person will become deaf by causes pertaining to the most powerful planet;
passages.notes: (a.) The Sun, the Moon, Mars and Saturn.
passages.summary: The text says that malefics in the 9th, 11th, 3rd and 5th houses without benefic aspect cause deafness from causes linked to the strongest planet.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: if such malefic planets (b) occupy the 7th house from the ascendant, the person will be of deformed teeth.
passages.notes: (b.) That is, [?] and not aspected by benefic planets.
passages.summary: The text says that if such malefics occupy the 7th house, the person will have deformed teeth.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person the eclipsed Moon occupy the rising sign and if Saturn and Mars occupy the 5th and 9th houses from the ascendant such person will be subject to the influence of ghosts.
passages.summary: The text says that an eclipsed Moon in the rising sign with Saturn and Mars in the 5th and 9th houses makes the person subject to the influence of ghosts.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Again, if, at the time of birth, the eclipsed Sun occupy the rising sign and if Saturn and Mars occupy the 5th and 9th houses from the ascendant, the person will lose his eyes.
passages.summary: The text says that an eclipsed Sun in the rising sign with Saturn and Mars in the 5th and 9th houses causes loss of the eyes.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, Saturn occupy the 7th house and Jupiter the ascendant, such person will be afflicted with windy complaints;
passages.summary: The text says that Saturn in the 7th house and Jupiter in the ascendant bring windy complaints.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: if, at the time of birth, Mars occupy the 7th house and Jupiter the ascendant, the person will become insane.
passages.summary: The text says that Mars in the 7th house and Jupiter in the ascendant make the person insane.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth, Saturn occupy the ascendant and Mars occupy the 5th, [?] or 9th house, the person will become an idiot.
passages.summary: The text says that Saturn in the ascendant with Mars in the 5th, 9th or another house (illegible) makes the person an idiot.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Also, if, at the time of birth, the waning Moon and Saturn occupy the 12th house, the person will also become an idiot.
passages.summary: The text says that the waning Moon and Saturn in the 12th house also make the person an idiot.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, one of the four planets — the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the Moon, the Sun, the Moon, and Jupiter — occupy the Navamsa of the lord of his depression sign or an inimical Navamsa, such person will serve under other men for his livelihood;
passages.summary: The text says that if one of four planets (the Moon's Navamsa lord, the Sun, the Moon, Jupiter) is in the Navamsa of its debilitation-sign lord or an inimical Navamsa, the person will serve others for a living.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: [the four planets — the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the Moon, the Sun, the Moon, and Jupiter —] if two of the four planets occupy either the one Navamsa or the other, he will become a slave;

passages.text: [the four planets — the lord of the Navamsa occupied by the Moon, the Sun, the Moon, and Jupiter —] if three of the planets or all the four occupy the one Navamsa or the other, the person will be the son of a slave.

passages.notes: (a.) These are the signs of Aries, Leo, Scorpio, Capricorn and Aquarius.

passages.text: if the Sun occupy the 9th or the 5th house from the ascendant and if he be aspected by malefic planets the person will be of weak sight;

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, the malefic planets occupy the 12th, [?], 2nd, and 9th houses in any way, such person will suffer imprisonment and restraint of the nature of the rising sign (a).
passages.notes: (a.) If the rising sign be Aries, Taurus or Sagittari, the person will be bound with ropes. If the rising sign be Gemini, Virgo, Libra or Aquarius, he will be loaded with fetters. If the rising sign be Cancer, Capricorn or Pisces the person will be shut up in a fortress but will be taken care of. If the rising sign be Scorpio, the person will be kept in a subterranean cellar.
passages.summary: The text says that malefics in the 12th, 2nd, 9th and one further house (illegible) bring imprisonment of a kind matching the rising sign.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: Again, if, at the time of birth, the rising Drekkana be either a Sarpa (b) (snake) Drekkana or a Pasa (c) (rope) Drekkana and if the sign (d) of its lord be aspected by malefic planets the person will also suffer imprisonment of the nature of such sign.
passages.notes: (b.) The Sarpa Drekkanas: These are the first Drekkana of Cancer, the 1st and 2nd of Scorpio, and the 3rd of Pisces. (c.) The Pasa Drekkana: This is the 1st Drekkana of Capricorn. (d.) That is, if the rising Drekkana be the first Drekkana of Cancer for instance, the lord of such Drekkana is the Moon whose sign again is Cancer. If the rising Drekkana be the 2nd Drekkana of Cancer, its lord is Mars whose sign is Scorpio and if it be the 3rd Drekkana of Cancer, the lord of such Drekkana is Jupiter whose sign is Pisces.
passages.summary: The text says that a rising snake or rope Drekkana whose lord's sign is aspected by malefics also brings imprisonment of the nature of that sign.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a person, the Moon be accompanied by Saturn, aspected by Mars and be surrounded by a halo, such person will be a man of harsh speech, will be afflicted with epilepsy and with consumption (a).
passages.notes: (a.) If the Moon be subject to the first of the three malefic Yogas, the person will be a man of harsh speech; if she be subject to the 2nd Yoga, the person will be afflicted with epilepsy; and if to the 3rd Yoga, the person will be afflicted with consumption.
passages.summary: The text says that the Moon with Saturn, aspected by Mars and surrounded by a halo, makes the person harsh of speech and afflicted with epilepsy and consumption.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth, the Sun, Saturn and Mars occupy the 10th house from the ascendant and if they be not aspected by benefic planets, the person will be a servant of varying rank — dignified, of moderate rank and of a low rank (b).
passages.notes: (b.) If one of the three planets occupy the 10th house the person will be a dignified servant. If two planets occupy the 10th house he will be a servant of middle rank and if three occupy the 10th house he will be a servant of low rank.
passages.summary: The text says that the Sun, Saturn and Mars in the 10th house without benefic aspect make the person a servant of dignified, middle or low rank.
passages.withheldReason: The chapter on malefic yogas, which predicts only misfortune.

passages.text: The same remarks apply to the horoscopy of women as to the horoscopy of men; but the effects which are suitable will alone affect women and the rest will affect their husbands. According to some all the effects (a) will affect the husband. The death of the husband shall be determined from the 8th house (from the ascendant) in the horoscope of a woman. Matters connected with the physique of a woman shall be determined from the rising sign and the sign occupied by the Moon and matters connected with her fortune and her husband shall be determined from the 7th house.
passages.notes: (a). Effects which can be enjoyed by both will affect both. Such effects as high appointments in the state will affect the husband and matters connected with the body will affect the woman only. Hence the advisability of a man marrying a girl born under excellent planetary Yogas.
passages.summary: The text says a woman's horoscope is read like a man's, but only the effects suited to a woman apply to her and the rest apply to her husband; some say all apply to the husband. It says the husband's death is judged from the 8th house, her body from the ascendant and the Moon's sign, and her fortune and husband from the 7th house.

passages.text: If the rising sign and the sign occupied by the Moon be even signs the woman will be of a true feminine character
passages.summary: The text says that if the ascendant and the Moon are both in even signs, the woman will be of a truly feminine character.

passages.text: [If the rising sign and the sign occupied by the Moon be even signs] and if such signs be aspected by benefic planets she will be virtuous and modest and will wear ornaments (a).
passages.notes: (a). According to some, virtues will be her ornaments.
passages.summary: The text says that if the ascendant and the Moon are in even signs and these signs are aspected by benefic planets, she will be virtuous and modest and will wear ornaments.

passages.text: But if such signs be odd the woman will possess a masculine shape and will be of masculine character;
passages.summary: The text says that if the ascendant and the Moon's sign are odd signs, the woman will have a masculine figure and a masculine character.

passages.text: [But if such signs be odd] and if they be either occupied or aspected by malefic planets she will be wicked and possess few virtues (b).
passages.summary: The text says that if these signs are odd and occupied or aspected by malefic planets, she will be wicked and have few virtues.

passages.text: (b). If either the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon be odd or even while the other sign is even or odd, the woman will partake of the character of a male and a female.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if one of the ascendant and the Moon's sign is odd and the other even, the woman will share the character of both a male and a female.

passages.text: A Similar remark applies when one of the signs is occupied or aspected by a malefic or a benefic planet and the other by a benefic or a malefic planet.
passages.summary: The translator's note says the same mixed result applies when one of these signs is occupied or aspected by a malefic and the other by a benefic.

passages.text: When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Aries or Scorpio, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of Mars, she will become unchaste before marriage;
passages.summary: The text says that if the ascendant or the Moon is in Aries or Scorpio and the relevant Trimsamsa belongs to Mars, she will have sexual relations before marriage.

passages.text: [When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Aries or Scorpio, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of] Saturn, she will lead a life of servitude.

passages.text: [When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Taurus or Libra, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of] Saturn, she will marry a second time;

passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Taurus or Libra and the Trimsamsa of Venus, she will have all good qualities and wide fame.

passages.text: Again, when the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Gemini or Virgo, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of Mars she will be deceitful;

passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Leo and the Trimsamsa of Venus, she will commit adultery with a person of a caste it calls low.

passages.text: When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Sagittarius or Pisces, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of Mars, she will possess many good qualities;
passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Sagittarius or Pisces and the Trimsamsa of Mars, she will have many good qualities.

passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Sagittarius or Pisces and the Trimsamsa of Saturn, she will have little interest in sexual union.

passages.text: [When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Sagittarius or Pisces, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of] Jupiter she will possess many good qualities;

passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Sagittarius or Pisces and the Trimsamsa of Mercury, she will be a woman of knowledge.

passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Sagittarius or Pisces and the Trimsamsa of Venus, she will not keep to sexual restraint.

passages.text: When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Capricorn or Aquarius, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of Mars she will lead a life of servitude;
passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Capricorn or Aquarius and the Trimsamsa of Mars, she will lead a life of servitude.

passages.text: [When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Capricorn or Aquarius, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of] Saturn she will join a person of low caste;
passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Capricorn or Aquarius and the Trimsamsa of Saturn, she will join a person of a caste it calls low.

passages.text: [When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Capricorn or Aquarius, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of] Jupiter she will be chaste;

passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Capricorn or Aquarius and the Trimsamsa of Mercury, her conduct (in the moral sense) will be judged unfavourably.

passages.text: [When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Capricorn or Aquarius, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of] Venus she [may have no children].
passages.printedText: [When the rising sign or the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman is either Capricorn or Aquarius, if the rising Trimsamsa or the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon be that of] Venus she will be barren.
passages.summary: The text says that with the ascendant or Moon in Capricorn or Aquarius and the Trimsamsa of Venus, she will have no children.

passages.text: The effects described for the rising Trimsamsa or those described for the Trimsamsa occupied by the Moon will come to pass according as the one Trimsamsa or the other is the more powerful.
passages.summary: The text says that whichever is more powerful, the rising Trimsamsa or the Moon's Trimsamsa, decides which of the described effects come to pass. It states a rule, not a result.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a woman, Saturn and Venus occupy each other's Navamsa and aspect each other or, if the rising sign be either Taurus or Libra and the rising Navamsa be that of Aquarius, the woman will quench the poisonous fire of her strong lustful desires by means of other women assuming a masculine character.
passages.summary: The text says that if Saturn and Venus are in each other's Navamsa and aspect each other, or if Taurus or Libra rises with the Navamsa of Aquarius rising, the woman will satisfy her strong desires with other women who take a masculine role.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon be not occupied by planets, and if such house be weak and not aspected by benefic planets, the husband of the woman will be wicked;
passages.summary: The text says that if the 7th house from the ascendant or the Moon is empty, weak and not aspected by benefics, the woman's husband will be wicked.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon] be occupied by Mercury the husband will be a hermaphrodite;
passages.summary: The text says that if Mercury is in the 7th house from the ascendant or the Moon, the husband will be a hermaphrodite.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon] be a movable sign, the husband will be travelling in foreign lands (a);
passages.summary: The text says that if the 7th house from the ascendant or the Moon is a movable sign, the husband will travel in foreign lands.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon] be occupied by the Sun, the woman will be rejected by her husband;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Sun is in the 7th house from the ascendant or the Moon, the woman will be rejected by her husband.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon] be occupied by Mars aspected by malefic planets, she will become a widow while young,
passages.summary: The text says that if Mars is in that 7th house aspected by malefics, she will be widowed while young.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon] be occupied by Saturn aspected by malefic planets she will remain unmarried to an old age.
passages.summary: The text says that if Saturn is in that 7th house aspected by malefics, she will remain unmarried until old age.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon] be a fixed sign the husband will remain in his place
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if the 7th house from the ascendant or the Moon is a fixed sign, the husband will stay in his own place.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon] be a common sign, he will travel to foreign lands but will be returning to his place every now and then.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if that 7th house is a common (dual) sign, the husband will travel abroad but return home from time to time.

passages.text: If the 7th house, from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman, be occupied by several malefic planets, the woman will become a widow;
passages.summary: The text says that if several malefics occupy the 7th house from the ascendant or the Moon, the woman will become a widow.

passages.text: [If the 7th house, from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman,] be occupied by several benefic and malefic planets she will quit her husband and marry another person
passages.summary: The text says that if several benefics and malefics occupy that 7th house, she will leave her husband and marry another person.

passages.text: [If the 7th house, from the rising sign or from the sign occupied by the Moon at the time of birth of a woman,] be occupied by a malefic planet (a), be weak, and be aspected by a benefic planet (b) the woman will be rejected by her husband.
passages.notes: (a). Either the Sun or Mars or Saturn. (b). Either Mercury or Jupiter or Venus.
passages.summary: The text says that if that 7th house holds a malefic, is weak, and is aspected by a benefic, the woman will be rejected by her husband.

passages.text: If Venus and Mars occupy each other's Navamsa the woman will commit adultery;
passages.summary: The text says that if Venus and Mars are in each other's Navamsa, the woman will commit adultery.

passages.text: and if the 7th house from the rising sign be occupied by the Moon, Venus and Mars, she will commit adultery with the permission of her husband.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon, Venus and Mars are in the 7th house from the ascendant, she will commit adultery with her husband's permission.

passages.text: If at the time of birth of a woman, the rising sign be that of Saturn (a) or Mars (b) and if it be occupied by the Moon and Venus and aspected by malefic planets, the woman and her mother will commit adultery;
passages.notes: (a). Capricorn or Aquarius. (b). Aries or Scorpio.
passages.summary: The text says that if a sign of Saturn or Mars rises, holding the Moon and Venus and aspected by malefics, the woman and her mother will commit adultery.

passages.text: if the setting Navamsa be that of Mars and if the setting sign be aspected by Saturn, the woman will possess a diseased genital organ;
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting Navamsa belongs to Mars and the setting sign is aspected by Saturn, the woman will have a diseased genital organ.

passages.text: and if the setting Navamsa be that of a benefic planet the woman will possess a fine genital organ and will become an agreeable wife.
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting Navamsa belongs to a benefic planet, the woman will have a fine genital organ and be an agreeable wife.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a woman, the setting sign or the setting Navamsa be that of Saturn, the husband of the woman will be an old man and a fool;
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting sign or setting Navamsa belongs to Saturn, the woman's husband will be old and foolish.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the setting sign or the setting Navamsa be that of] Mars, the husband will be of irascible temper but will be attached to his wife.
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting sign or Navamsa belongs to Mars, the husband will be quick-tempered but attached to his wife.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the setting sign or the setting Navamsa be that of] Venus, the husband will be beautiful and fond of his wife;
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting sign or Navamsa belongs to Venus, the husband will be handsome and fond of his wife.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the setting sign or the setting Navamsa be that of] Mercury, the husband will be learned and intelligent.
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting sign or Navamsa belongs to Mercury, the husband will be learned and intelligent.

passages.text: If the setting sign or the setting Navamsa at the time of birth of a woman be that of the Moon, the husband will be full of lustful desires and of a quiet nature.
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting sign or setting Navamsa belongs to the Moon, the husband will be full of desire and of a quiet nature.

passages.text: [If the setting sign or the setting Navamsa at the time of birth of a woman be that of] Jupiter, the husband will possess courage and other virtues and will have a control over his passions and desires;
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting sign or Navamsa belongs to Jupiter, the husband will be courageous and virtuous and will control his passions.

passages.text: [If the setting sign or the setting Navamsa at the time of birth of a woman be that of] the Sun, the husband will be of very soft nature and will engage in many works (a).
passages.summary: The text says that if the setting sign or Navamsa belongs to the Sun, the husband will be very gentle and engaged in many works.

passages.text: (a). According to some the reading of this portion of the text is Ratikarma instead of Atikarma, in which case the meaning is that the husband will indulge much in sexual union.
passages.summary: The translator's note says some read the text differently, so that with the setting sign or Navamsa of the Sun the husband will indulge much in sexual union.

passages.text: Again if the setting sign be that of one planet and the setting Navamsa be that of another planet, then, the effects described for such sign or Navamsa, whichever is powerful, will come to pass.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that if the setting sign and setting Navamsa belong to different planets, the effects of whichever is more powerful will come to pass. It states a rule, not a result.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a woman, the rising sign be occupied by the Moon and Venus, the woman will be envious of the prosperity of other persons and will be greatly mindful of her comforts;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon and Venus are in the ascendant, the woman will envy others' prosperity and care greatly for her comforts.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the rising sign be occupied by] the Moon and Mercury the woman will be learned in the fine arts, will be in the enjoyment of comfort and will possess many good qualities;
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon and Mercury are in the ascendant, the woman will be learned in the fine arts, live in comfort and have many good qualities.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the rising sign be occupied by] Venus and Mercury the woman will be beautiful, much liked by her husband and learned in music, vocal and instrumental;
passages.summary: The text says that if Venus and Mercury are in the ascendant, the woman will be beautiful, much liked by her husband, and learned in vocal and instrumental music.

passages.text: [If, at the time of birth of a woman, the rising sign be occupied by] the Moon, Mercury and Venus, the woman will be in the enjoyment of immense wealth and comfort and possessed of many good qualities.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon, Mercury and Venus are in the ascendant, the woman will enjoy immense wealth and comfort and have many good qualities.

passages.text: If the rising sign be occupied by Mercury, Jupiter and Venus, the same remarks apply.
passages.summary: The text says that if Mercury, Jupiter and Venus are in the ascendant, the same results apply as for the Moon, Mercury and Venus there: immense wealth, comfort and many good qualities.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 8th house from the ascendant be occupied by a malefic planet, the woman will become a widow and the widowhood will occur in the Antardasa period of the planet whose Navamsa is occupied by the lord of such 8th house.
passages.summary: The text says that if a malefic occupies the 8th house, the woman will become a widow, in the sub-period of the planet whose Navamsa holds the 8th lord.

passages.text: If the 8th house be occupied by a malefic planet and if the 2nd house be occupied by a benefic planet the woman will die before her husband
passages.summary: The text says that if a malefic is in the 8th house and a benefic in the 2nd, the woman will die before her husband.

passages.text: and if the Moon occupy sign Virgo, Scorpio, Taurus or Leo, she will have very few sons.
passages.summary: The text says that if the Moon is in Virgo, Scorpio, Taurus or Leo, she will have very few sons.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a woman Saturn be neither powerful nor weak, the Moon, Venus and Mercury be weak, and the Sun, Mars and Jupiter be powerful and if the rising sign be odd, the woman will be of a masculine character (a).
passages.summary: The text says that if Saturn is of middling strength, the Moon, Venus and Mercury are weak, the Sun, Mars and Jupiter are strong, and an odd sign rises, the woman will be of masculine character.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a woman, Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury be powerful and if the rising sign be an even sign, the woman will be of wide spread fame, will be vastly learned and learned also in the Science of Divinity.
passages.summary: The text says that if Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury are strong and an even sign rises, the woman will be widely famous, very learned, and learned in sacred knowledge.

passages.text: (a). According to some the woman will enjoy many men.
passages.summary: The translator's note says that according to some, under the first combination of this verse the woman will have relations with many men.

passages.text: If, at the time of birth of a woman, the 7th house from the rising sign be occupied by a malefic planet while the 9th house is occupied by some planet, the woman will without doubt become an ascetic of the class belonging to the planet occupying such 9th house (a).
passages.notes: (a). And the other effects already described will fail.
passages.summary: The text says that if a malefic is in the 7th house and some planet is in the 9th, the woman will certainly become an ascetic of the order belonging to the planet in the 9th house.

passages.text: All that has been said in this chapter apply to the positions of the planets at the time of promise of gift of girl in marriage, of such gift and of marriage (b), also at the time of query.
passages.notes: (b). Provided such effects do not clash against the effects described in the chapters on Marriage. (vide Chapters 100 and 303 of Brihat Samhita).
passages.summary: The text says everything in this chapter also applies to the planetary positions at the time of betrothal, of giving the girl in marriage, of the wedding, and of a query. It states a rule, not a result.
